  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related technical field
  • Extensive embedded Linux experience – Yocto or other
  • Extensive Linux experience – Debian or Ubuntu preferred
  • Fluency in at least one of Golang, Python, C, C++ or Rust
  • Ability to manage a small team
  • Experience with customer engagements
  • Professional written and spoken English
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Result‑oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • An ability to communicate the business benefits of technology
  • An humble learner and quick study

Other desirable traits include RTOS experience, additional languages (both the programming and human kinds), and previous experience working in a remote‑first, diverse, distributed company.

What We Offer

  • Distributed work environment with twice‑yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. title: Director, School Counseling and University Admissions
description:
Want to revolutionize the future of education and do meaningful work that transforms future generations’ lives?

Our team is looking to bring on passionate educators to support our growing student base through part‑time teaching roles. This position offers the opportunity to teach bright, motivated students from around the world while maintaining flexibility in your schedule. You'll play a key role in delivering high‑quality, personalized learning experiences as we continue to expand our reach globally

POSITION OVERVIEW

We are seeking a Director of School Counseling and University Admissions to serve as a critical bridge between our A-level and US curriculum pathways. This role combines strategic leadership with hands‑on student counseling to ensure every CGA student receives world‑class university guidance while building scalable systems that maintain excellence as we grow.

The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in both US and UK education systems, demonstrated success in placing students in top universities globally, and the vision to create comprehensive programs that develop future‑ready students. This role requires someone who can work directly with students requiring personalized counseling while simultaneously building the infrastructure, playbooks, and training materials that enable consistent counseling quality across our global team.

Purpose

Support students across both curriculum pathways (A-level and US) to help ensure a unified approach to setting students up for success and consistency of practice for academic excellence. This role acts as a bridge between the two curriculum pathways, ensuring that students have the support they need to choose the path that best aligns with their future goals. You'll provide hands‑on student counseling support for top universities, support clubs, create enrichment programs, and build scalable systems to ensure students arrive at the application stage well‑prepared with strong academic foundations, examination results, rich extracurricular profiles, global competencies in real‑world experiences, and clear university pathways aligned to personal goals and CGA's institutional strengths.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Cross-Pathway Leadership & Coordination

  • Facilitate knowledge sharing and best practice exchange between campuses and across curriculum types (A-level and US pathways)
  • Collaborate with academic staff, admissions teams, and deans to align curricular offerings with student outcomes and market demand
  • Monitor and benchmark academic performance across campuses and curricula to drive continuous improvement
  • Ensure consistency of practice for academic excellence across both curriculum pathways
  • Work as part of an extended team across time zones to support our global nature

Examination Management & Academic Performance

  • Support examination management across A-levels, AP, and SAT programs
  • Develop and oversee comprehensive exam preparation programs across all curricula
  • Implement data-driven strategies to improve student outcomes
  • Support accreditation and compliance for institutional relationships

Academic Enrichment & Future-Ready Student Development

  • Create programs that develop globally competitive students prepared for the future of work
  • Support and coordinate academic competitions to build student competitiveness
  • Develop real-world experiences and vibrant community connections for students
  • Support student clubs and enrichment programs
  • Ensure students develop strong academic foundations, rich extracurricular profiles, and global competencies
  • Build connections between students and opportunities that develop future-ready skills

Clubs & Extracurricular Programs

  • Design and implement a comprehensive club structure and system across CGA that ensures consistency and quality
  • Support student clubs and organizations to foster community connection in a virtual environment
  • Create frameworks and guidelines for club formation, leadership, and sustainability
  • Develop and maintain a diverse portfolio of extracurricular opportunities aligned with university admissions expectations
  • Ensure student leadership development through club participation and officer roles
  • Monitor club engagement and participation to identify opportunities for student connection
  • Build partnerships with external organizations to provide authentic extracurricular experiences
  • Track and document student extracurricular involvement for university applications
  • Create virtual and asynchronous club opportunities that accommodate students across time zones

Direct University Admissions Counseling

  • Deliver world‑class university admissions counseling through direct student support
  • Work directly with a select cohort of high‑intensity students requiring comprehensive personalized counseling
  • Provide strategic planning for university applications, including subject selection and pathway decisions
  • Manage predicted grades and letters of recommendation for students
  • Guide students through UCAS, Common App, and country-specific application systems
  • Ensure students meet all deadlines across multiple application systems globally
  • Review and provide feedback on personal statements, essays, and supplemental materials
  • Provide comprehensive guidance on university selection across US, UK, Canadian, European, Australian, Asian, and other international systems
  • Coordinate financial aid and scholarship applications with families
  • Maintain current knowledge of admissions requirements, deadlines, and trends across global universities

Building Scalable Systems & Infrastructure

  • Build scalable systems that ensure all CGA students receive expert guidance through their application process
  • Create comprehensive counseling playbooks and frameworks for counselors and deans to follow
  • Develop standardized processes for predicted grades, recommendation letters, and application quality assurance
  • Build training materials and resources to establish consistent counseling quality across the team
  • Establish quality standards and benchmarks for university counseling
  • Design asynchronous resources supporting part‑time students through their application journeys
  • Develop and maintain an extensive database of university programs, scholarships, and requirements globally
  • Build systems that can evolve as our school grows

Data & Performance Tracking

  • Support data dashboards tracking application progress and outcomes for areas of improvement
  • Ensure data is transparent and reportable across all school leadership
  • Track and analyze university admissions outcomes to inform program improvements
  • Generate reports on student outcomes and program metrics
  • Use data to identify trends and optimize counseling strategies

Strategic Partnerships & Market Intelligence

  • Monitor global education and admissions trends to adjust CGA's approach and maintain competitive advantage
  • Cultivate relationships with university admissions offices to enhance CGA's institutional reputation
  • Build partnerships with universities to create opportunities for CGA students
  • Represent CGA at virtual university fairs and recruitment events
  • Stay informed about test‑optional policies, holistic admissions trends, and evolving university requirements

Student Support & Academic Advising

  • Advise students on course rigor, AP subject selection, A-level subject combinations, prerequisites, and graduation requirements
  • Provide counseling to address academic stress, time management, and study skills
  • Support students navigating the unique challenges of online learning
  • Serve as an advocate for student needs within the school community
  • Coordinate with families through virtual information sessions and regular communication
  • Create learning environments where every student discovers and develops their unique strengths

Administrative & Compliance

  • Maintain accurate student records and university application tracking systems
  • Prepare school reports, transcripts, and counselor recommendation letters
  • Collaborate with school leadership on policy development and strategic planning

LEADERSHIP VALUES & APPROACH

As a leader across pathways at CGA, this role will need to be an exemplar of our values:

  • Unlock Potential Together: We work collaboratively. No team is an island. Adapt quickly and find solutions that are in the best interests of our families and CGA as a whole. Every student is a VIP. Make decisive actions to propel us forward through a lens of optimism.
  • Rethink, Rebuild: Avoid defaulting to, "We've always done this."Be curious, look outside your sphere of inspiration, and dive into the data for actionable insights. Online is our advantage. Let's make the most of the innovation at our fingertips. Take immediate action to improve always, take accountability, follow through, and get ready to optimize again.
  • Raise the bar, compound impact: Continually strive to be better tomorrow. Have high standards for yourself and those around you. Tackle hard things with grit, take your work seriously, but not yourself. Take the time to document work, proactively share learnings, and multiply others’ efforts. Give credit to those making a positive impact.

QUALIFICATIONS

Education & Credentials

  • Master's degree in School Counseling, Guidance Counseling, Higher Education, or related field
  • Valid school counseling credential/license (or equivalent from home country)
  • Demonstrable expertise in both US and UK education systems

Experience

  • Minimum 5-7 years of experience in high school college counseling or university admissions
  • Proven track record of successfully placing students in competitive universities globally
  • Experience building scalable systems, frameworks, or programs in an educational setting
  • Experience working with international students or in an international school setting
  • Demonstrated knowledge of university admissions processes in multiple countries (US, UK, Canada, Europe, Asia, Australia)
  • Deep experience with both AP and A-level curriculum pathways
  • Familiarity with online/virtual education delivery
  • Experience with data analysis and using metrics to drive program improvement

Knowledge & Skills

  • Expert knowledge of US university admissions (Common App, Coalition App, UC system, liberal arts colleges, Ivy League)
  • Expert knowledge of UK university admissions (UCAS, Russell Group, requirements for Oxbridge)
  • Working knowledge of university systems in Canada, Australia, Europe, and Asia
  • Understanding of international baccalaureate equivalencies and credit transfers
  • Proficiency with student information systems and college planning software (Naviance, Scoir, Cialfo, or similar)
  • Strong knowledge of scholarship and financial aid resources globally
  • Familiarity with FERPA, GDPR, and educational privacy laws
  • Ability to develop training materials, playbooks, and scalable processes

Technical & Communication Skills

  • Excellent virtual communication and presentation skills
  • Proficiency with video conferencing platforms (Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams)
  • Strong written communication skills for emails, reports, recommendation letters, and counseling materials
  • Ability to use learning management systems and collaboration tools
  • Digital literacy and comfort with educational technology
  • Experience with data visualization and dashboard creation for tracking outcomes

title: Especialista em Planejamento Energético
description:
Sinta a nossa energia!

Somos um time de 16 mil colaboradores próprios, espalhados por 18 estados brasileiros e no Distrito Federal. Aqui, os sotaques se misturam, integração, colaboração e segurança são elementos fundamentais em nosso dia a dia. Atuamos em toda a cadeia do setor elétrico brasileiro, Geração, Transmissão, Distribuição e Comercialização. Juntos, somos essa Neoenergia toda!

Queremos liderar a transição energética no Brasil e ser a escolha número 1 para brasileiros e brasileiras. E faremos isso com pessoas de todos os gêneros, raças, idades, orientações sexuais e com deficiências. Investimos em diversidade, inovação e tecnologias para oferecer a melhor experiência de soluções energéticas conectadas a cada um dos nossos 16 milhões de clientes!

Local de Trabalho:

Flamengo/ Rio de Janeiro.

Sua Energia Será Muito Importante Para

Liderar a execução de modelos de preço/operação do mercado de energia brasileiro, envolvendo preparação da base de dados e premissas técnicas e regulatórias para execução, bem como analisar/interpretar os resultados da execução dos modelos e compará-los com a operação do ONS e benchmarking externos. Além da execução dos modelos, seu conhecimento envolve acompanhar os principais KPIs da operação e expansão do SIN, bem como do mercado de energia brasileiro, além de propor premissas fundamentalistas para estudos de evolução do preços de energia no longo prazo.

Atividades

  • Liderar tecnicamente a execução do processo de previsão de preços/operação do sistema no curto, médio e longo prazo
  • Acompanhar fóruns de discussões, FTs e alterações regulatórias no âmbito do ONS, CCEE, EPE e ANEEL
  • Buscar evolução metodológica das execuções, propondo automações para maior agilidade, eficiência e mitigação de erros
  • Elaborar premissas fundamentalistas da evolução do preço de energia e balanço estrutural no longo prazo (evolução carga, matriz elétrica e limites de intercambio ao longo do tempo)
  • Avaliar a operação e expansão tanto do SIN quanto do mercado de energia brasileiro
  • Projeção de Encargos, GSF e Bandeiras Tarifárias do SIN
  • Prover suporte técnico-analítico para os clientes de Trading, Portfólio, Comercial, Distribuidoras do grupo e Desenvolvimento de Negócios
  • Elaboração de estudos especiais sobre efeitos financeiros de sazonalização e modulação para as usinas do grupo

Para Fazer Parte Do Nosso Time, Você Precisa Ter

  • Formação Superior Completa em Engenharia, economia ou demais formações com foco em exatas
  • Vivência avançada na aplicação dos modelos energéticos: NEWAVE, DECOMP, DESSEM ou SDDP, bem como os modelos satélites SMAP, Weol e PrevCargaDessem
  • Conhecimento avançado em Pacote Office (word, excel, power point)

Será Um Diferencial Se Você Tiver

  • Vivência avançada com Linguagens de Programação (Python, VBS, R…)
  • Pós-graduação em Planejamento Energético, Métodos de Apoio à decisão ou áreas correlatas
  • Conhecimento de Regras de Comercialização
  • Conhecimento avançado de Inglês ou Espanhol

Para você ficar com a energia lá em cima, confira nossos benefícios:

  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico para cuidar de você e de seus dependentes.
  • Vale Alimentação para fazer aquele mercado reforçado ou Vale Refeição para confraternizar com os colegas no horário de almoço.
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados da empresa, o momento mais esperado do ano!
  • Licença maternidade estendida, para um puerpério com mais tranquilidade.
  • Licença paternidade, para ficar bem perto da sua família nos primeiros dias do bebê.
  • Licença para casais homoafetivos, porque aqui reconhecemos todos os tipos de família.
  • Trabalho Híbrido para colaboradores administrativos.
  • Gympass para você fazer atividade física e ficar cheio de energia.
  • Programa de Idiomas para você poder se aperfeiçoar em outro idioma.
  • Auxílio Creche para te apoiar com o cuidado dos seus filhos.
  • Previdência Privada para você ter um futuro mais tranquilo.
  • Seguro de Vida para apoiar nossos colaboradores em todos os momentos.

description:

You take ownership of architectural decisions and are comfortable translating business and platform requirements into repeatable Azure foundations. You value clean design, governance, and automation, and you collaborate closely with application, DevOps, security, and infrastructure teams.

You thrive in complex enterprise environments, communicate technical concepts clearly, and act as a technical reference for Azure architecture, networking, security, and platform automation.

You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience architecting and operating solutions in Microsoft Azure.

  • Proven experience implementing Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF) and Azure Landing Zones.
  • Strong hands‑on expertise with Terraform, including modular design and remote state management.
  • Strong experience with Azure DevOps, including YAML pipelines and CI/CD governance.
  • Solid experience designing hub‑and‑spoke network architectures and hybrid connectivity.
  • Hands‑on experience with Docker and Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).
  • Strong understanding of cloud security, governance, and enterprise‑scale architecture.
  • Experience implementing Azure security controls, RBAC, policies, and compliance standards.
  • Strong problem‑solving skills and clear technical communication.
  • Azure certifications (AZ‑305, AZ‑400, AZ‑104, AZ‑204) and/or Terraform certification (nice to have).
  • Advanced English proficiency is required, as you will work directly with US‑based clients.

You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Design and implement Azure tenant architectures aligned with Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework and Azure Landing Zone best practices.
  • Define and manage management group hierarchies, subscription strategies, and environment separation.
  • Establish standardized patterns for identity, networking, security, governance, and logging.
  • Build and maintain Terraform‑based Infrastructure as Code and integrate it into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Design and maintain multi‑stage Azure DevOps pipelines for infrastructure and platform automation.
  • Architect and support enterprise networking, including hub‑and‑spoke topologies and hybrid connectivity.
  • Implement and enforce Azure security, governance, and compliance controls.
  • Collaborate with application, DevOps, security, and infrastructure teams on platform adoption.
  • Provide technical guidance and architectural direction to engineering teams.
  • Continuously improve platform reliability, scalability, and operational excellence.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of hands‑on experience designing and operating Azure cloud architectures
  • Proven experience implementing Azure Landing Zones and Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF)
  • Strong hands‑on experience with Terraform (Infrastructure as Code)
  • Experience with Azure DevOps and CI/CD pipelines (YAML)
  • Advanced English proficiency.

Additional Information

About Us

At Applaudo , we partner with ambitious companies to transform through technology with an AI‑native mindset at the core of how we think, build, and deliver. We combine strategic clarity, world‑class execution, and modern engineering practices to help clients accelerate measurable business outcomes and stay competitive.

We are building a high‑performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we make decisions, and how we hold ourselves accountable.

Applaudo is a place for people who want to grow fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and embracing AI as a lever for productivity, innovation, and impact.

title: Planning and Integration Manager FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027TM
description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Job Description

The position

This role focuses on coordinating operational planning, integration, risk and issue management, to ensure successful delivery of the tournament, hosted in Brazil.

The Project Manager will work with internal and external stakeholders, including FIFA and FIFA27, host cities, government entities, and venue authorities, to achieve excellence in planning, readiness, and execution.
This position offers a unique opportunity to shape the success of one of the most prestigious global sporting events and leave a lasting legacy for women’s football in Brazil and beyond.

The Project Manager will be a key role during tournament time, co-ordinating day-to-day operations at the Tournament Operations Centre and coordinating with stakeholders to resolve issues.
Travel and flexibility to work irregular hours may be required due to the nature of the event.

Key responsibilities
Project Management and Integration

  • Under the direction of FIFA’s Lead of FWWC Portfolio Management based in Zurich, implement the FIFA Project Management framework throughout the planning, readiness, implementation and closure phases of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 project.
  • Assist to implement project management processes and standards within FIFA27.
  • Coordinate cross-functional and venue teams to ensure the integration of operational, venue and client planning activities.
  • Collaborate with Functional Areas (FAs) in FIFA27, Host Cities, and stakeholders to develop and implement comprehensive function and venue operating plans (Project Definitions, Operations Plans and Site Operational Plans).
  • Assist in the development of tournament-wide contingency plans and ensure functional area and venue alignment.
  • Assist in the development and maintenance of the master project plan, critical roadmap from a FIFA27 perspective, capturing all key milestones and tasks and the monitoring thereof.
  • Provide strategic and operational support, including tracking progress, risk-issue monitoring, and milestone adherence.

Reporting

  • Assist in the delivery of the Tournament Operations Centre (TOC) structures and systems to facilitate coordination and issue resolution.
  • Provide regular updates and reporting to senior leadership and stakeholders on progress, risks and issues. Help to compile presentations to senior management
  • Compile standardised reports on project progress, risks, and dependencies to ensure alignment with governance structures
  • Data extraction, consolidation and visualisations

Operational and Client Planning

  • Coordinate the development of client and functional operating plans, policies, and procedures using FIFA templates.
  • Assist in the definition and integration of client journey plans in collaboration with key stakeholders.
  • Manage the agreement process for client service levels and priorities.
  • Ensure consistency in planning and delivery across competition and non-competition venues.
  • Support Functional Areas in FIFA27 in preparing and maintaining activity and event schedules, monitoring risks, issues, and resource requirements.

Risk Management

  • Enable risk management processes, including identification, mitigation, and escalation of risks and issues across FIFA27.
  • Ensure compliance with ISO 31000 standards for risk management.
  • Support the development of strategic contingency plans.
  • Work with Functional Areas in FIFA27 to ensure risks are identified, documented and mitigated effectively.

Operational Readiness

  • Plan and conduct readiness exercises, including simulations, rehearsals, and testing of infrastructure, systems, and processes.
  • Build the capability of functional area and venue teams through tailored readiness activities.
  • Capture and implement lessons learned from readiness activities to optimize tournament delivery.
  • Prepare for tournament time by transitioning into the day-to-day coordination and issue management role within the Main Operations Centre.

Knowledge Management

  • Contribute to FIFA’s knowledge management initiatives, including the Observer Program, debriefs, lessons capture, and post-tournament reporting.
  • Ensure proper transfer of knowledge through documentation, photo capture, and archiving of key materials for future events.

Training and Development

  • Provide training to FIFA27 users on FIFA’s project management methodology and tools.
  • Ensure consistent application of project management principles across the organization.

Your profile

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Business, Project Management, or a related field.
  • Knowledge of event planning and project management processes.
  • Familiarity with various project management methodologies, including Agile and Scrum, is an advantage.

Experience

  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in leading complex, large-scale projects, preferably in international mega-events or sports events.
  • Proven track record in developing and executing strategic and operational plans.
  • Experience managing stakeholder relationships across government, corporate, and community groups.

Excellent Python skills are a key requirement, with previous contributions to open source Python projects being an advantage. The Pro client often interacts with the Ubuntu package management; therefore, experience in configuring apt, and knowledge of deb packaging and general system administration is advantageous in this role.
Applicants should be passionate about the Ubuntu project and its values and about building tools that are used by millions of people around the world. A personal interest and emphasis on quality, thinking of edge cases, ease of use, documentation, and careful community coordination is important. The Pro client is used at all ranges, from mission-critical environments to hobbyist Ubuntu users; applicants should be ready to work with the whole spectrum of end users and help guide engineering best practices with all of them in mind.
The role entails

  • Collaborate proactively with a distributed team
  • Write high quality code, with unit and functional tests, to create new features
  • Debug issues and produce high quality code to fix them

  • You love technology and working with brilliant people

  • You have a Bachelor's or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degree

What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals.   • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year

  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. title: Brazil - Remote: Team Lead - Digital Twin Platform
description:
Overview

We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.

Job Duties

We are building a platform that merges real-time physics, structured knowledge, and autonomous intelligence. You will be the technical anchor for a team of Senior Engineers handling:

  1. Backend: Ingesting massive sensor streams and running multi-agent AI systems.
  2. Data: Organizing tons of industrial data into a Medallion Architecture.
  3. Frontend: Building the 'Control Room' and complex AI interfaces.
  4. DevOps: Deploying across hybrid cloud (AWS/Azure) and edge (K3s) environments.

Your challenge is to ensure these distinct pieces fit together, ensuring the backend model is consumable by the frontend’s 'Visualizations' and that the 'Data Pipelines' are reliably deployed by DevOps.

What You’ll Do

  • Technical Orchestration: You will drive cross-boundary architectural decisions. You will decide how the Backend serves live telemetry to Frontend dashboards and how Data Engineering pipelines feed the Knowledge Graph .
  • Code & Quality Standards: Enforce high standards across the stack. You will review API designs (FastAPI), ensure the Frontend maintains strict Component Architecture, and verify that Data pipelines implement appropriate quality gates.
  • The 'Expert': When the DevOps engineer faces a connectivity issue between Cloud and On-Prem, or the Backend engineer struggles with concurrency in a distributed stream, you are the senior voice in the room, guiding the solution.
  • Team Leadership: Conduct code reviews, mentor senior developers, and translate high-level product requirements into technical tasks (ADO) for the squad.

The Technology Stack

You do not need to be an expert in every single tool, but you must be able to discuss technical trade-offs across the entire stack:

  • Backend: Python 3.12+ (FastAPI), Kafka, Neo4j, LangGraph.
  • Frontend: Angular 16+, TypeScript, RxJS, Plotly.js.
  • Data: Apache Airflow, Delta Lake, Polars/Spark.
  • Infrastructure: Kubernetes (EKS/AKS/K3s), Terraform, Hybrid Cloud

Qualifications

Desired Profile

  • The Architect-Implementer: You can draw the system architecture on a whiteboard, but you are not afraid to open an IDE to debug a failing pipeline or a slow query.
  • The Polyglot: You are likely a Backend or Full-Stack native, but you understand the complexity of Frontend state management (NgRx/Signals) and the constraints of Medallion Data Architectures.
  • Reliability Mindset: You understand that we are dealing with critical industrial environments. You prioritize testing, validation, and security.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

Must Haves:

  • 10+ years of experience in Software Engineering, with at least 2+ years leading technical teams.
  • Deep proficiency in Python Backend Development .
  • Solid understanding of Frontend complexity (SPA architecture, async data loading).
  • Experience designing or managing Data Intensive Applications (understanding ETL, Streams, or Data Lakes).
  • Familiarity with DevOps/Cloud concepts (Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD).
  • Advanced English communication skills.

Good to Have:

  • Streaming: Proficiency with Streaming Technologies (Kafka, Flink, Spark) and Time-Series Databases (TimescaleDB, InfluxDB).
  • GenAI: Practical experience building applications with LLMs, Agentic Frameworks (LangGraph), and Vector Databases.
  • Graph: Hands-on experience with Graph Databases (Neo4j/Cypher), SQL database design, and Hybrid Search strategies
  • Experience with Digital Twins , IoT, or Industrial Data.
  • Experience with GenAI/LLM architecture (RAG, Agents).
  • Background in Heavy Industry, O&G, or IoT data (MQTT, OPC UA).
  • Experience with Local LLMs (Ollama) for privacy-focused deployments.
  • Familiarity with Data Lineage or Metadata management.

title: Security Engineer Brazil, Sao Paulo
description:
Nubank was founded in 2013 to free people from a bureaucratic, slow and inefficient financial system. Since then, through innovative technology and outstanding customer service, the company has been redefining people's relationships with money across Latin America. With operations in Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia, Nubank is today one of the largest digital banking platforms and technology-leading companies in the world.

Today, Nubank is a global company, with offices in São Paulo (Brazil), Mexico City (Mexico), Bogotá (Colombia), Durham (United States), and Berlin (Germany). It was founded in 2013 in São Paulo, by Colombian David Vélez, and cofounded by Brazilian Cristina Junqueira and American Edward Wible. For more information, visit .

About the Role

We are looking for a Security Engineer to lead the architecture and automation of our global security infrastructure. In this role, you will drive the strategy for endpoint and network defense across on-premises and multi-cloud environments (AWS, GCP, Azure), operating with high autonomy to solve complex, undefined security challenges. You will be responsible for building tailor‑made solutions and establishing the standards that protect a platform impacting millions of lives.

As a technical leader, you will bridge the gap between deep execution and organizational influence. You will lead cross‑functional initiatives, mentor engineering teams, and advise on long‑term security investments and roadmaps. We need a defensive security expert who combines strong technical reasoning with the ability to reduce complexity, guide technical debates, and deliver high‑scale results in a fast‑scaling, customer‑obsessed environment.

Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and support multi‑country security solutions for on‑premises and cloud infrastructures (endpoint and network), including defining and developing automation to enable large‑scale deployments and operation;
  • Develop and maintain security policies and documentation for new endpoint and network technologies, contributing to high‑level documentation for non‑engineers and detailed technical documentation for engineering teams;
  • Ensure secure configuration and management of endpoints, network systems, and security applications using appropriate security platforms, tools, and operating‑system‑specific controls;
  • Support risk assessments related to endpoints, networks, and information protection, helping identify and mitigate security exposures;
  • Support security reviews and audits, assisting internal audit teams with endpoint and network security issues and compliance activities, and participating actively in discussions;
  • Support to respond to cyber threats, incidents, and anomalies affecting endpoints and networks, anticipating technical issues at the enterprise and platform level and making architectural and design decisions to prevent them;
  • Evaluate build‑vs‑buy alternatives under general direction, articulating trade‑offs between technical, analytical, and platform needs, efficiency vs. thoroughness, and the impact on technical debt.

Required Skills and Expertise

  • Strong understanding of operating systems (Windows, macOS, Linux) and core security protocols, including authentication, authorization, and cryptographic principles;
  • Knowledge of network technologies, including routing, switching, network security protocols, and cloud networking (AWS, GCP, Azure);
  • Knowledge of application‑layer technologies, business continuity, disaster recovery (DRP), and secure system design;
  • Experience with research, analysis, and data‑visualization tools, as well as identity and access management, security operations, and security analytics;
  • Experience with automation and programming languages (e.g., Python and Go), including the ability to develop scripts, tools, and system integrations.
  • Technical expertise with cloud and on‑premises infrastructures, including secure architecture, deployment, and operations;
  • Experience in major incident management and security incident response across endpoints, networks, and cloud environments;
  • Experience in listening and guiding technical debates to help reach a consensus;
  • Ability to conduct in‑depth analysis of computer networks and systems to identify vulnerabilities, misconfigurations, and security gaps;
  • Awareness of the latest attack techniques, threat actor behaviors, and methods used to compromise systems and networks;
  • Strong soft skills, including effective communication with technical and non‑technical stakeholders, the ability to guide technical debates, and fast, informed decision‑making during critical events.

description:
Banco de Talentos (Técnico de Segurança do Trabalho)

Descrição da vaga

Acompanhar e/ou implementar os programas de segurança, proteção e meio ambiente, seguindoou produzindoos seguintes processos: PPRA, CIPA, CAT, DDS e etc., fiscalizando e acompanhando o uso dos EPI´s, controlando a data de expiração dos equipamentos e materiais, elaborando relatórios fotográficos, além de palestras e integrações de novos funcionários.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Distribuir diariamente aos colaboradores, os EPI`s que serão usados, recolhendo aqueles danificados e separando-os, anotando na ficha pessoal de cada colaborador o que foi retirado e qual a data do trâmite, para fins de enviar uma notificação ao Auxiliar Administrativo para posterior compra, cumprimento da legislação e reserva da integridade física do colaborador. Fazer levantamento diário do estoque de todo o material de segurança do trabalho (entradas e saídas), anotando em planilha manual a relação dos materiais que faltam, repassando ao Administrativo, para fins de reposição de estoque. Visitar diariamente as áreas operacionais, para fins de inspeccionar a segurança nas áreas. Fazer vistoria de veículos mensalmente, verificando pessoalmente os freios, faróis e etc., informando aos Terceirizados caso haja necessidade de algum reparo, lançando em planilha feita no Word os problemas relacionados ao veículo e enviando ao Gerente de Filial os problemas encontrados, para fins de manter os veículos em boas condições e segurança dos colaboradores. Fazer análise de risco baseando-se nas atividades que serão feitas pelas equipes, definindo qual será o EPI usado, qual o processo mais seguro para a realização da atividade, enumerando os possíveis riscos, para fins de preservar a integridade física dos colaboradores. Fazer diariamente a inspeção de segurança, especificando as não conformidades existentes nos locais, fazendo um relatório e encaminhando ao Gerente de Filial ou à empresa responsável, para fins de preservar a integridade física do colaborador e do Meio Ambiente. Responsável por elaborar todo trâmite relacionado à eleição da CIPA e os documentos de mesma, exigidos pelo Ministério do Trabalho e Emprego, para fins de atender a fiscalização trabalhista. Fazer cumprir as ações da CIPA em acordo com o SMS, identificar necessidades, planejar, executar e avaliar programas de treinamento de segurança industrial e meio ambiente; Controlar mensalmente o SESMT, número de acidentes ocorridos em cada setor, através de notificação do ocorrido, reunindo as CATS, análise de levantamento de acidentes, fazendo um parâmetro e calculando as horas perdidas, total de cada setor, enviando as cópias ao Gerente de Filial e a empresa CSN, para fins de controle do número de acidentes e as horas perdidas. Notificar eventualmente, através de comunicado feito em planilha Excel, uma análise do acidente ocorrido através de simulações ou depoimentos, traçando medidas corretivas, enviando ao Supervisor de área em que ocorreu o acidente, para fins de prevenir acidentes com a mesma proporção. Preencher eventualmente no site do INSS, uma CAT no prazo máximo de quarenta e oito horas após o acidente, informando a lesão ocorrida, o local e a hora, o agente causador, a situação causadora, imprimindo uma cópia e arquivando, fornecendo cópia ao colaborador, e enviando através do site do INSS, para fins de comunicar ao INSS, preservar o colaborador de possíveis dificuldades trabalhistas e a empresa de possíveis processos trabalhistas. Coordenar eventualmente a troca ou efetiva recarga de extintores, inspecionando um a um, mantendo contato direto com a empresa responsável pela manutenção dos extintores para fins da Triunfo estar preparada caso ocorra algum incêndio. Promover eventualmente a integração dos novos colaboradores, apresentando os riscos a que são expostos, ensinando os procedimentos e análises de riscos, fazendo um treinamento total dos mesmos, apresentação através de Power Point, dando palestras em sala de reuniões, apresentando-os aos seus Supervisores, para fins de mostrar os riscos aos novos colaboradores, apresentar-lhes as responsabilidades e obrigações dentro da empresa. Elaborar mensalmente no Word, gerando cópias e distribuindo em locais de livre acesso aos colaboradores um jornal interno, imputando informações preventivas e atualidades, para fins de fornecer informações e gerar uma integração. Fiscalizar diariamente as Unidades, com o intuito de assegurar que o DDS (Diálogo Diário de Segurança) está sendo cumprido, arquivando e assinando o DDS, para fins de promover a conscientização e prevenção de acidentes entre os colaboradores. Preencher eventualmente uma planilha enviada pelo Porto de Itaguaí, constando a entrada e saída de resíduos da oficina, entregando ao Chefe de Oficina, que é responsável pelo recolhimento, para fins de conformidade junto à FEEMA. Representar eventualmente, a empresa na CPATP (Comissão de Prevenção de Acidentes de Trabalhadores Portuários), participando de reuniões ordinárias e semestrais para fins de justificar problemas e tomar as devidas providências. Planejar, coordenar, orientar tecnicamente, avaliar e realizar estudos, avaliações e inspeções das condições de trabalho, quanto aos aspectos de higiene industrial, segurança industrial e meio ambiente, em áreas, equipamentos, instalações. Elaborar documentação necessária para a abertura da Comunicação de Acidente de Trabalho e encaminhar para o Setor de Recursos Humanos para que a mesma seja emitida. Orientar os membros da CIPA para os assuntos ligados a saúde e higiene, através da participação em reuniões e da realização de palestras na semana de prevenção da empresa, visando prevenir doenças e acidentes de trabalho. Indicar e orientar a implementação de medidas preventivas de segurança em toda área industrial, administrativa e proteção ao meio ambiente. Fazer cumprir as ações da CIPA em acordo com o SMS, identificar necessidades, planejar, executar e avaliar programas de treinamento de segurança industrial e meio ambiente. Fazer plano de ação para cumprimento do Anexo SMS escopo do Contrato, apresentando evidências para PETROBRAS. Participar de programas de auditorias de SMS, segurança industrial e de meio ambiente, acompanhar as atividades operacionais nas áreas contratuais, visando à segurança do profissional envolvido, bem patrimonial e meio ambiente. Investigar análises de acidentes e ocorrências anormais, planejando e executando Plano de Ação trazendo segurança nas operações. Elaborar planos de contingência e coordenar atividades de controle de emergências para todas as áreas contratuais, proceder de acordo com os padrões técnicos e normas operacionais.

Job Description Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

Canonical is founder led, profitable and growing. We are hiring an Embedded Linux Field Engineer for Devices/IoT to expand our reach in mission-critical industries such as Automotive, Medical Devices, Industrial Systems, Robotics, and Telco, as well as Consumer Electronics. We are looking for candidates who are accomplished Linux plumbers. If you are someone passionate about Linux, who knows the plumbing of the OS inside and out, who is proficient with distribution packaging, software design, system debugging, and bringing customer's ideas to life, then please keep on reading – this may be a uniquely exciting opportunity for you.

The server edition of Ubuntu is already widely used in connected devices and industrial PCs. Our newer edition of Ubuntu for IoT, called Ubuntu Core, represents the state of the art in security and resilience for high end appliances and equipment. Our customers include global brands in consumer and industrial electronics as well as automotive and robotics. We continue to expand our range of offerings to bring our security, management and developer experience to the smallest Linux environments and devices. In Agoda’s Engineering department, we build the scalable and fault‑tolerant systems. Our systems cover all major areas of our business: website, mobile apps, affiliate apis, inventory and pricing, product information, customer data, communications, partner data, booking systems, payments, finance and more. These mission‑critical systems change frequently with dozens of releases per day, so we must employ state‑of‑the‑art CI/CD, experimentation and advanced testing techniques in order to make sure everything works without any downtime. We also ensure that our systems are self‑healing, responding gracefully to extreme loads or unexpected input. In order to accomplish this, we use state‑of‑the‑art languages like React, Redux state management, Javascript, Kotlin, Scala, data technologies like Kafka, Aerospike and Big Data, and agile development practices. Most importantly though, we hire great people from all around the world and empower them to be successful. Whether it’s building new projects like Flights and Packages or innovating on the latest fintech idea or reimagining our existing business, you’ll make a big impact as part of our Engineering team.

The Opportunity

The Senior Engineering Manager role at Agoda is one of the most significant and challenging roles in Technology. The right candidate has both deep technical knowledge and exhibits extremely strong leadership and people development skills. The right candidate will have a keen interest in developing people: inspiring those around them so they can achieve their potential. Being able to bring A‑players such as yourself from outside and integrating them into the business will also be important.

description:
Quem somos

A Longitude é uma consultoria internacional independente de design e engenharia , especializada em projetos nos setores de energia, marítimo, naval, offshore e renováveis . Parte do ABL Group , atuamos globalmente apoiando clientes ao longo de todo o ciclo de vida de ativos complexos, sempre com foco em segurança, excelência técnica, inovação e sustentabilidade .Com uma atuação integrada globalmente, a Longitude conta também com umtime no Brasil , que trabalha de forma colaborativa com equipes internacionais, conectando expertise local ao know-how global do grupo.

Nossa missão, visão e valores

? Missão
Entregar soluções de engenharia confiáveis e eficientes, apoiando nossos clientes na execução de projetos complexos com alto padrão técnico e segurança.

?️ Visão
Ser referência global em engenharia marítima e offshore, reconhecida pela qualidade, inovação e desenvolvimento de pessoas.

  • Safety first – segurança sempre em primeiro lugar

Sobre a vaga

Você atuará como Process Safety Engineer , integrando a equipe de Engenharia de Processos , com foco na identificação, análise, mitigação e gestão de riscos de segurança de processos em FPSOs e plataformas offshore , tanto flutuantes quanto fixas.

Além da atuação nos projetos locais, o profissional interagirá ativamente com projetos da Longitude ao redor do mundo , trabalhando de forma integrada com equipes multidisciplinares e multiculturais. Essa atuação inclui o compartilhamento de conhecimento técnico, melhores práticas de segurança de processo e o suporte técnico a projetos internacionais , contribuindo para a consistência técnica e a excelência em engenharia de segurança em toda a organização.

? Garantir a conformidade com normas e códigos internacionais aplicáveis à segurança de processos.

? Gerenciar interfaces técnicas com outras disciplinas (Processo, Instrumentação, Elétrica, Naval, Estrutural e Operações).

? Atuar como ponto focal técnico de segurança de processo junto a clientes, parceiros e equipes globais.

Graduação completa em Engenharia Química, Engenharia de Processos, Engenharia Mecânica ou áreas correlatas.

Experiência sólida em Process Safety aplicada a projetos offshore .

Conhecimento e aplicação de normas e boas práticas internacionais de segurança de processo.

Queremos que nossos colaboradores tenham sucesso tanto no trabalho quanto na vida. Para apoiar isso, promovemos um ambiente de trabalho saudável, produtivo e flexível que respeite o equilíbrio entre vida pessoal e profissional.

Through science, policy, fieldwork, and finance, we spotlight and secure the most important places in nature for the climate, biodiversity, and for people. POSITION SUMMARY

This position has a hybrid working arrangement, working remotely some days and in the office on others. This role can be based in Arlington-VA, Bolivia, Colombia, Peru, Costa Rica, Mexico, Ecuador, Brazil (remote), Belgium, United Kingdom (remote), or Germany (remote).

The Cloud Solutions Developer will lead the design, development, and optimization of the organization’s web and cloud systems. This position combines hands-on technical expertise with strategic leadership, ensuring secure, scalable, and cost-effective solutions that enable our mission globally.

This is a unique opportunity to apply technical skills in a purpose-driven organization where your work will directly support environmental sustainability, community engagement, and global impact.

What We Offer

  • Hybrid work flexibility – giving you the option to work remotely some days and connect in person on others (Fully remote work available in Brazil).

People & Resource Management

Qualifications

Required

title: Dressing & Signage Cluster Manager
description:
Overview

Department: Technical & Infrastructure

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

The Position

The Dressing & Signage Cluster Manager reports to the Dressing and Signage Senior Manager, serving as a key member of the FIFA27 Operations team in close collaboration with the Venue Management team and other stakeholders. The FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™ requires outstanding look and feel project to be delivered in a seamless tournament experience. The Dressing & Signage Cluster Manager is responsible for leading the venue branding, look and signage operations and delivery strategy from planning through implementation to closure across all FIFA Official Sites. This position is responsible for overseeing the delivery of a world class dressing and signage project for all target groups attending matches of the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™, ensuring that the look and feel is up to FIFA quality standards.

The role assumes event operational proficiency, venue dressing, signage and wayfinding knowledge with project management skills to directly overseeing the dressing implementation at four FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™ stadia. They will ensure that key project deliverables and deadlines are met within their sites and will be required to input into strategic project decisions taken by senior members of the team. They will oversee contracted provider operations within their sites, ensuring that all are managed successfully and efficiently while monitoring budgetary spending within agreed limits. They will ensure that precedents and strategic directives from the Head of Dressing and Signage and Senior Dressing and Signage Manager are followed as required by the members of the team. The role will collaborate closely with other dressing, signage, wayfinding and non-competition managers to maximize creativity and ensure consistency across all stadiums.

Key Responsibilities

  • Overseeing the turnkey planning of dressing and signage implementation across all official sites during planning phase, and stadium dressing for 3-5 stadia closer to the tournament.
  • Collaborating with the other Stadium Dressing Managers and ensuring that precedents are followed to guarantee consistency across all tournament stadiums.
  • Working closely with the Non-Competition Dressing Managers and the Wayfinding and Signage Managers as well as other Functional Area Managers, to maximize efficiencies across the wider project.
  • Being the focal point for all general stadium dressing questions or requests from the Head of Department.
  • Oversight of contracted provider planning, production and implementation for all stadiums within the assigned sites.
  • Constant monitoring of the budgetary impact of dressing operations and reporting updates to the Senior Manager and Head of Department regularly.
  • Providing strategic input into the stadium dressing planning process and offering expertise when required.
  • Adhering to project deadlines and deliverables as instructed by senior members of the department.
  • Daily liaison with other members of the wider Dressing and Signage team to ensure efficient planning and delivery is optimized at all stages of the project.
  • Liaising with stadium owners and operators as required to gain approval on implementation plans.
  • Presenting to senior team members, management and other FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™ functional areas as and when required.
  • Attending department-specific and organization site visits at assigned stadiums and other stadiums or official sites.
  • Inputting into the site-specific dressing strategies utilizing expertise from previous events and directives from management.
  • Acting as the main stadium dressing point of contact for Dressing and Signage Venue Managers and other Functional Area Venue Managers within the assigned sites during the implementation phase of the project.
  • Participating in the creative design process for stadiums within the assigned sites.
  • Assisting with the recruitment of Dressing and Signage project team members in collaboration with the senior department leads if required.
  • Ensuring the needs of internal FIFA functional areas are captured and delivered against within the assigned sites.
  • Contribution to project management and knowledge management initiatives including event debriefs, and knowledge capture and documentation activities.
  • Ability to possibly be relocated to a Host City for up to three months in to act as a Dressing and Signage Venue Manager at an allocated stadium during the event periods.

Your Profile

  • Minimum 4+ years of experience in delivering dressing, signage, branding or look projects for events of a similar scale to FIFA World Cups, Olympic Games etc. or a minimum 2 years’ experience managing major sports events in a role that included the delivery of comprehensive dressing or signage related activities.
  • A working understanding of the technical aspects of delivering dressing and signage projects (i.e. production methods, installation techniques, materials etc.).
  • Strong understanding of stadium look and feel requirements and large-scale temporary installations.
  • Budget management experience on complex and multi-faceted events and projects.
  • Experience in managing providers of services for world-class events.
  • Knowledge of event planning, requirements and event project management processes for large sporting events.
  • Significant stakeholder management experience across multiple organizations and departments.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess and implement effective solutions.
  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in appropriate subject (or adequate training/vocational education) Design, Architecture, Project Management, or a related field.
  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning software and online collaboration tools.
  • The role will require extensive use of the appointed Dressing and Signage Supplier(s) project, content and scoping management systems so a readiness to learn new technology processes, systems and programs is essential.
  • The role will require attending site visits and being away from home for periods of time, including on-site attendance during the tournament period.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

title: Project Engineer Integrity
description:
Overview

The Project Engineer Integrity will support offshore projects and life-extension activities by providing practical marine and structural engineering input. The role focuses on project execution, offshore readiness, integrity assessments, inspections, repairs, and MOC support, ensuring safe and compliant implementation of structural and marine modifications.

Responsibilities

  • Participate in concept selection, FEED, detailed design and execution of offshore brownfield and life-extension projects.
  • Provide marine and structural engineering input for FPSOs and other offshore structures.
  • Translate engineering deliverables into offshore execution scopes, including workpacks, methodologies, inspection strategies, and lifting/installation philosophies.
  • Interface with class societies, marine warranty surveyors, and inspection vendors on structural and marine matters.
  • Review, approve or coordinate structural analysis reports, integrity assessments, repair plans, reinforcement strategies and life-extension studies.
  • Support offshore campaigns involving inspections, repairs, modifications, installations or remediation works.
  • Work closely with marine, construction, operations, and HSE teams to ensure offshore readiness and safe execution.
  • Provide engineering support for structural integrity, reassessment, and life-extension of offshore assets.
  • Support Management of Change (MOC) processes related to structural and marine modifications.
  • Review inspection findings and define required repair, reinforcement or mitigation actions.
  • Support troubleshooting during offshore anomalies, impacts, or structural damage events.
  • Capture lessons learned from offshore activities and incorporate them into project practices and design standards.

Education

  • BSc or MSc in Civil, Structural, Offshore, or Marine Engineering.
  • Advanced degrees in Offshore Structures or Systems are considered a strong advantage.
  • Extensive relevant experience may compensate for formal education.

Experience

  • Minimum 6 years’ experience in oil & gas, ideally with offshore brownfield or FPSO background.
  • Proven experience with FPSOs, semisubmersibles or topside structures.
  • Experience in structural integrity and reassessment.
  • Experience in life-extension and RBI activities.
  • Experience in offshore inspections and repair campaigns.
  • Experience working with class societies and offshore regulatory frameworks.
  • Strong exposure to project execution and offshore operations, not only design.

Knowledge

  • Strong understanding of Offshore steel structures
  • Structural integrity, fatigue, buckling, and yielding
  • Marine and structural interfaces
  • Familiarity with international standards and practices (e.g. ABS, API, ISO, DNV).
  • Experience with structural analysis and FEM tools (e.g. FEMAP/NX, ANSYS, ABAQUS).
  • Solid understanding of offshore inspection methodologies and repair techniques (including composite repairs).

title: Network Manager
description:
Network Manager

Department: Technology

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

Reporting organizationally to the Senior Telecoms Manager, the Network Manager (NWM) will be a key member of the FIFA27 Technology team. The NWM will work closely with the FIFA Technology teams and the Stadia Teams, as well as other stakeholders. The NWM will understand the stadia legacy network ensuring it will support FIFA’s needs during the FWWC 2027. The NWM will also manage the integration between FIFA’s Game’s Time network and the legacy network.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Manage the planning, delivery, and operations of network infrastructure for FIFA and Local FIFA Subsidiary (LFS) offices, FIFA Special Events, and the FIFA Women’s World Cup.
  • Review and validate Network Infrastructure designs, ensuring all deliverables—hardware, passive infrastructure, cybersecurity, monitoring, alerting, etc.—are implemented according to FIFA standards across venues and offices.
  • Actively participate in scope definition, procurement processes, supplier selection, and onboarding of Telco and Network service providers.
  • Lead the deployment and implementation of network infrastructure, securing timely availability of components and services, including the commissioning and decommissioning of event venues.
  • Oversee the effective and efficient delivery of Network services for FIFA offices, tournaments, and selected FIFA events. Monitor progress, report status, identify risks, and ensure alignment with IT governance.
  • Perform equipment configuration, testing, handover, monitoring, and troubleshooting activities.
  • Support network-related projects by clarifying requirements, following robust change management procedures, and ensuring clear communication across stakeholders.
  • Provide technical guidance, mentoring, and coaching to team members, including preparing best-practice materials and training resources
  • Create and/or manage KPIs dashboards for operating stadia networks (FIFA’s and legacy) for the Telecom Command Center (TCC)

YOUR PROFILE

Education

  • University degree or similar higher education, in Information Technology, Computer Science, Telecommunications Engineering or related field

Experience

  • Minimum of 8 years overall IT experience and minimum 4 years of experience in a similar role
  • Prior experience in the Sports / major event industry is highly preferred
  • Proven experience of successful delivery of complex network infrastructure projects

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong technical expertise in telecom service provider networks, wired/wireless infrastructure design and deployment, network integration, and connectivity.
  • Proven experience with WAN/LAN, MPLS, VPN, routing and switching technologies, and multicast operations.
  • Relevant technical certifications (e.g., CCNP, CCIE, CISSP) or equivalent professional experience.
  • Solid understanding of structured cabling (copper and fiber) in heterogeneous environments.
  • Excellent consulting, negotiation, communication, and facilitation skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem‑solving capabilities.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to train and present to diverse audiences.
  • Team‑oriented mindset with the ability to work under tight deadlines.
  • Demonstrates patience, persistence, and a positive attitude.
  • Experience delivering wireless networks in complex, high‑density environments.
  • Grafana, PowerBI and other BI related tools for creating dashboards or collecting data.

Certifications & Requirements

  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Fluent in English
  • Native or Fluent in Portugues
  • Proficiency in any other FIFA language (FR / ES / GER) is an asset

Various

  • Willing to travel within Brazil (up to 30%), with some trips with a long duration (15 days or more)

Canonical Overview

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office‑based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder‑led, profitable, and growing.

Canonical's Partner Engineering Team is looking for open‑source enthusiasts to work across the full Linux stack to ensure new silicon technologies, such as new hardware accelerators, AI stacks, confidential computing, networking, virtualization, and containerization stacks, are optimised for new silicons.

Partner Engineering works closely with worldwide silicon companies to optimise Ubuntu for their new silicon, from x86, ARM, RISC‑V, PowerPC and s390x architectures.

Location: This is a Globally remote role

  • Collaborating proactively within a distributed team
  • Fostering a software ecosystem with seamless user experience for all Ubuntu users

  • Collaborating with other teams in the Ubuntu and Debian communities, with upstream projects, and commercially supported customers
  • Debugging issues on open source code and team‑maintained code.
  • Help customers integrate their apps, SDKs, build OS images, optimise applications with Ubuntu Core, Desktop and Server
  • Work with a team to maintain Ubuntu, silicon features, and silicon‑optimised packages across platforms and technologies such as:
    • Servers, HPC and AI systems, IoT devices, PCs, SmartNICs and automotive systems
    • AI stacks
    • Graphics, audio and multimedia stacks
    • Virtualisation and Containers
    • Hardware enablement stacks
    • New architectures, architecture variants and optimised toolchains
    • Package management and dependencies
    • Platform security (secure boot, FDE, Ubuntu Core, Confidential Computing)
  • Work from home with global travel 2 to 4 weeks for internal events

Qualifications

  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path
  • Love technology and working with brilliant people
  • Curious, flexible, articulate, and accountable
  • Value soft skills and are passionate, enterprising, thoughtful, and self‑motivated
  • Value building partnerships with a diverse set of internal and external groups
  • Strong fundamentals in C, C++ and Python
  • Experience or interest in learning Linux distribution packaging
  • Experience or interest in open source maintenance or contribution and licences
  • Fundamental understanding of package management and dependency resolution

Additional Skills That You Might Also Bring

  • Experience with one or more of the following:
    • Graphics, audio, or multimedia stacks
    • Virtualisation and containers (Docker, OCI, Kubernetes)
    • Hardware enablement for platforms and devices, including SmartNICs, NVMe storage, GPUs, audio components, and sensors
    • Performance optimisation
    • Toolchain development and maintenance
    • Networking protocols and technologies (TCP/IP, DHCP, HTTP/REST)

What We Offer

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance‑driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programmes to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long‑haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence – in order to succeed we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote‑first company since its inception in 2004. title: Evolved Packet Core - 5G Architect
description:

Type: Full-time

1GLOBAL is a technology-driven global mobile communications provider dedicated to empowering enterprises worldwide to unlock the full growth potential of mobile connectivity. With a best-in-class telecom technology platform, a comprehensive suite of globally viable regulatory licenses, and privileged access to the telecom wholesale market, 1GLOBAL is uniquely positioned to deliver seamless compliance and connectivity solutions. Serving the world’s leading banks, corporations, and digital-first businesses—including neo-banks, travel companies, and payment service providers—1GLOBAL connects over 43 million devices globally.

With 2024 full-year revenue exceeding US$100 million and in line to exceed US$200 million in FY25, 1GLOBAL is a profitable business generating significant cash flows to fund its ongoing investments in infrastructure, transformation, and growth. 2024 saw major client wins and marked 1GLOBAL’s evolution from a multi-market telecommunication provider to a global technology-driven mobile connectivity powerhouse.

Established in 2022 by experienced tech founders and entrepreneurs Hakan Koç and Pyrros Koussios, 1GLOBAL is a European technology leader driving digital transformation in the global telecommunications market. It operates as a fully regulated Mobile Virtual Network Operator (“MVNO”) in ten countries and as a regulated telecommunications operator in an additional 31 countries. Headquartered in the Netherlands, with world‑class R&D hubs in Lisbon, Berlin, and São Paulo, 1GLOBAL employs over 450 experts across 15 countries.

Position Overview

As a Network Architect, in the Network Team, you will be responsible to propose, analyze and define the requirements for new and existing services and systems, in the functional domain of Evolved Packet Core and 5G SA Core.

You will be responsible for preparing, designing, testing, and delivering new solutions or enhancements to the existing product portfolio. Additionally, you will define and support the technology evolution roadmap for systems within the assigned functional area and domain, while also actively participating in and supporting cross-functional projects in collaboration with other functional areas.

Key Responsibilities

  • Collaboration with other Networks teams in defining and managing the projects for delivery of new solutions
  • Project delivery. Network design. Integration and migration strategy definition. Collaboration with other relevant departments. Responsible for end-to-end delivery
  • Iterates with the customer (internal and external) and other stakeholders to determine the technical requirements, risks, technical impacts, and recommendations
  • Design of new consumer and corporate telecom solutions
  • Creation of technical documentation (HLD’s, LLD’s, WO’s, etc.) and maintain it over the lifecycle of the solutions
  • Understanding of End to End system testing requirements
  • Follow-up and define Quality and Performance indicators
  • Capacity and Performance Analysis, Reporting and Improvement Solution Definition
  • Service & Resource configuration definition and implementation on requested systems
  • Work on complex solutions that influence the design of current products and addresses design issues for future products or technologies
  • Market prospection of new solutions through elaboration and analysis of Request for Information/Proposal/Quotation processes and negotiation with potential suppliers
  • Elaborate, and manage the process, for change requests to current partners in order to meet the network necessities
  • Control the network elements roadmap, being responsible for the necessary software/hardware upgrade during the components lifecycle
  • Generate and implement process improvements, including and especially cross-team processes
  • Follow up of new technology trends in the Telecom industry. Documents the existing technology portfolio and proposes recommendations for improvements and/or alternatives

Requirements

Must Have

  • Proven experience on implementation of live solutions on mobile telecom (GSM, UMTS, LTE, IMS), networks design, capacity management, engineering and architecture
  • Knowledge of 3GPP, GSMA, ITU standards and specifications
  • Experience in the design, test and operation of Packet Core systems, including P-GW, RADIUS, DNS, PCRF, ePDG, DRA
  • Experience in defining, establishing and maintaining roaming interconnects for GRX/IPX
  • Understanding about IMS architecture. Experience in deploying VoLTE, VoWiFi, and QoS
  • Experience in designing, implementing, testing and troubleshooting the following interfaces: Gx, RADIUS, SGi/Gi, Gy, Bp, S6b, S2b, SWm, Sxb
  • Experience in mobile services charging (offline, online).
  • Experience in Policy control, including DPI and PCRF policy creation
  • Experience with IoT, including LTE-M and NB-IoT
  • Knowledge and experience with Diameter/SCTP networks and protocols
  • Knowledge and experience with protocols such as RADIUS, GTP-C, GTP-U, Diameter, MAP, S6a
  • Experience with protocol analyzer tools like Wireshark, Astelia, and ability to use them to troubleshoot networks errors/problems for the mentioned protocols
  • Experience with ETSI NFV architecture and solutions
  • Familiar with MVNO/MVNE/MVNA architecture(s) and landscape
  • English proficiency mandatory, other languages are a plus
  • Degree in Telecom Engineering or Computer Science or equivalent experience

Nice to Have

  • +8 years working on telecoms, designing and implementing mobile core networks
  • +3 years in a telecom strategy role
  • Experience in 5G Core design, implementation and operation
  • Previous experience with Nokia and Affimed Networks EPC products

What we offer?

  • CLT contract — enjoy job stability and reliable benefits that value your work
  • Quarterly performance bonuses to reward your hard work and achievements
  • Meal allowance paid into Caju card —R$100 per working day
  • Health insurance with SulAmérica —50% covered by the company
  • Extended parental leave - 180 days of maternity leave and 20 days of paternity leave.
  • Daycare allowance provided to mothers with children under 3 years old —R$500 per month per child
  • Kickstart your journey with an exciting welcome onboarding trip to one of our European offices (Lisbon or Berlin)!

Why 1GLOBAL?

  • Growth Opportunities: Advance your career in one of the fastest growing telecommunications companies, expanding over 100% year-on-year under the leadership of successful tech entrepreneurs.
  • Major Transaction Exposure: Be in the driver’s seat for transactions that will have an impact on the future telco industry.
  • Work with a Talented Team: From the Board and the Founders to the Senior Management Team, you will collaborate daily with the most capable and renowned external advisors, and constantly being exposed to talented and driven individuals.
  • Dynamic Work Environment: Thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced workplace where innovation is encouraged, and every contribution counts.
  • Professional Development: Work alongside industry experts to enhance your skills and knowledge in a cutting‑edge field.
  • International Experience: Gain opportunities to work in different 1GLOBAL offices around the world as you grow within the company.
  • Open Communication Culture: Join a team where your ideas are heard, and open dialogue is encouraged, fostering a supportive and transparent work environment.
  • Get Things Done Attitude: Be part of a results‑driven team that values efficiency, creativity, and the drive to make a tangible impact in the industry.

1GLOBAL is an equal opportunity employer, we value your character as much as your talent. Diversity drives our innovation, and we offer a collaborative, dynamic, and international work environment. We are excited for you to join our mission to revolutionise connectivity globally.
