title: Rust Engineering Lead - Linux and Open Source
description:
Rust Engineering Lead – Linux and Open Source

We are hiring Rust Engineering Leads of all levels of experience to drive the adoption of this exciting language into the full range of Canonical offerings, starting with Ubuntu but also our own projects and open source offerings. We see Rust as an important new language for system level services and capabilities, and a natural evolution path for the sort of software that would traditionally have been written in C or C++. We believe that there is an opportunity to rethink the foundations of future Linux systems with Rust as a central driver of change in everything from the system firmware and embedded software, bootloaders, up through the kernel and input handling, all the way to the desktop.

We also want to ensure that Ubuntu is the very best platform for Rust development, offering easy access to the widest range of tooling and capabilities that support cutting edge open source and enterprise development. This role will help keep Ubuntu the best platform for developers wanting to write Rust code for the full 99% of our user base.

After the first round of interviews we'll find the best fit product team at Canonical for you to progress your application based on your personal interests. We expect the highest engineering standards and strong motivation to get things done well in a fully home‑based and distributed environment.

These roles require extensive personal experience with Linux – the more different versions of Linux the better!

Location : we have open roles for Rust engineers in every time zone.

What your day will look like

  • Design and implement well‑tested and well‑documented software in Rust
  • Advocate for Rust adoption in Canonical and upstream projects
  • Identify projects and codebases that could be prioritised for Rust adoption
  • Debug and fix issues encountered by your users
  • Participate in our engineering process through code and architectural reviews
  • Collaborate with community and colleagues on technical specifications
  • Seek improvements to engineering and operations practices
  • In some cases, deploy and operate services developed by the team
  • Contribute to the success of your product through technical advocacy

What we are looking for in you

  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path
  • For more senior roles, experience building, deploying, and operating distributed systems and APIs
  • Drive and a track record of going above‑and‑beyond expectations
  • Well‑organised, self‑starting and able to deliver to schedule
  • Appreciative of diversity, polite and effective in a multi‑cultural, multi‑national organisation
  • Professional manner interacting with colleagues, partners, and community
  • Experience designing and writing high‑quality Rust software on Linux
  • Experience with and passion for Linux at the system level
  • Professional written and spoken English
  • The work ethic and confidence to shine alongside motivated colleagues
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Passion, thoughtfulness, and self‑motivation
  • Result‑oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks each

Nice‑to‑have skills we would value

  • Experience developing for Ubuntu
  • Experience with LXD, MicroK8s, SnapD, IoT, Juju, Ubuntu Core, Ubuntu Pro
  • Performance engineering and security experience

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance‑driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice‑yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open‑source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

Join Our Team Oowlish, one of Latin America's rapidly expanding software development companies, is seeking experienced technology professionals to enhance our diverse and vibrant team. The ideal candidate is a hands‑on leader who has successfully guided development teams toward higher velocity, quality, and operational excellence by introducing and optimizing AI‑powered practices. Responsibilities

  • AI-Driven Development Transformation:
    • Accelerate SDLC: Lead the adoption of Generative AI tools and coding assistants to reduce cycle times and eliminate repetitive engineering tasks drastically.
    • Measure Impact: Define and track KPIs related to AI adoption (e.g., velocity increase, code quality metrics, reduction in technical debt) to prove ROI.
    • AI Governance & Ethics: Establish a secure framework for using AI tools within the company, ensuring strict adherence to data privacy, IP protection, and security compliance standards.
  • Technical Architecture & Innovation:
    • Architectural Oversight: Design and oversee the roadmap for complex, scalable platforms, ensuring they are built for resilience and future growth.
    • Tech Stack Modernization: Continuously evaluate and optimize our infrastructure and cloud strategy to support high-performance AI integration.
    • Mentorship: Provide high-level technical guidance to Principal Engineers and Architects, resolving complex blockers and fostering technical excellence.
  • Organizational Leadership & Scaling:
    • Team Building: Build and structure high-performing engineering teams from the ground up, optimizing for agility and cross‑functional collaboration.
    • Process Optimization: Implement "AI-native" workflows that redefine how we hire, onboard, and manage engineering talent for maximum output.
    • Culture of Innovation: Foster an environment where experimentation is encouraged, but accountability and delivery are paramount.
  • Commercial & Client Strategy:
    • Serve as the primary technical voice in high‑stakes client meetings, simplifying complex architectural concepts into compelling business value propositions.
    • Business Growth: Partner with Sales and Product teams to articulate the competitive advantage of our AI-enabled development processes to prospective clients and investors.
    • Client Solution Viability & Compliance: Ensure the flexibility and compliance of AI adoption strategies (governance, tools, data privacy) to meet the diverse security and regulatory requirements of our clients.

Must Have

  • Senior Leadership Experience: 5+ years in a senior technology role (VP of Engineering, CTO, or Deputy CTO) with a focus on software delivery.
  • AI Implementation Track Record: Demonstrable experience leading the transformation of engineering teams through Generative AI (e.g., LLMs for code generation, automated testing suites, and documentation).
  • Proven ROI Analysis: Expertise in quantifying the efficiency gains derived from technical initiatives and reporting these to executive stakeholders.
  • Governance Expertise: Strong understanding of security risks and governance associated with using third‑party AI tools in an enterprise environment.
  • Communication Skills: Exceptional ability to bridge the gap between technical complexity and business strategy for non‑technical audiences.
  • Modern Tech Stack Expertise: Hands‑on experience working with several modern technologies such as .NET, Python, React/React Native, Angular, Next.js, TypeScript, among others. This includes the ability to guide teams across diverse frameworks, evaluate technological trade‑offs, and define best practices across frontend, backend, and full‑stack development.
  • Infrastructure Background: Deep experience in large‑scale system architecture and cloud ecosystems (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
  • Language Skills: Full fluency in English (required). Fluency in Spanish and or Portuguese is considered a strong plus.

title: Security Software Engineer
description:
Overview

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

Canonical is looking for exceptional security-focused software engineers to be integrated across product teams. While they also contribute to the product as engineers, their primary focus is to challenge the entire team to think more deeply about security through state-of-the-art practices such as threat modeling, table-top exercises, architecture and design reviews, static analysis tools, and fuzzing, among others. These roles encompass all aspects of product security, including feature development, vulnerability response, proactive security, and open source community participation. Engineers in these roles collaborate closely with other Canonical teams, customers, and partners across the open source ecosystem. Each product engineering team at Canonical reserves one or two openings for security-oriented software engineers. We also develop a number of products driven entirely by security needs, such as our AppArmor kernel investments and the Ubuntu Security Guide (USG). As the publisher of Ubuntu, we also handle long-term security response for the entire operating system and open source ecosystem. Working with tens of thousands of upstreams means that we need to be fluent in every major programming language and design, build, and adopt sophisticated tools that enable us to work at scale and speed with confidence. Apply here if you are an exceptional security-focused software engineer, passionate about open source, and excited by Canonical's products and mission. This role requires the ability to be productive in a globally distributed team through strong self-discipline and motivation. It also involves mandatory international travel at least twice a year, typically for one week. Location: Worldwide, this is a globally remote role

What you’ll do

Security roles might tackle any of the following:

  • Define, implement, and document new security features
  • Lead security-focused initiatives within a product engineering team
  • Analyze, fix, and test vulnerabilities in open source software
  • Contribute to Ubuntu and upstream open source projects to benefit the community
  • Audit and analyze source code for vulnerabilities
  • Integrate new tools into our security infrastructure, pipelines, and processes
  • Achieve and retain various security certifications
  • Extend and enhance Linux cryptographic components to meet country-specific compliance requirements, such as FIPS and Common Criteria (CC) certifications
  • Work with external partners to develop Center for Internet Security (CIS) benchmarks
  • Design and develop hardening automation for Ubuntu
  • Stay up to date with trends and developments in the security industry
  • Develop, test, and maintain new software capabilities
  • Provide guidance and support to other engineering teams on security best practices

What we are looking for in you

  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path
  • A track record of going above and beyond expectations
  • Thorough understanding of the common categories of security vulnerabilities and how to fix them
  • Knowledge of modern software engineering techniques
  • Familiarity with open source development tools and methodologies
  • Skill in one or more of C, C++, Python, Go, Rust, Java, Ruby, PHP, or JavaScript/Typescript
  • Experience as a security champion
  • Experience driving security within a wider SSDLC process
  • Professional written and spoken English
  • Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Passion, thoughtfulness, and self-motivation
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills
  • Results-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments

Optional skills we also value

  • Clear and effective communication with both the team and Ubuntu community members
  • Experience working with the Linux kernel
  • Experience with security certifications and knowledge of FIPS and/or Common Criteria (CC)
  • Experience with OVAL (Open Vulnerability Assessment Language)
  • Knowledge of cryptographic modules such as OpenSSL and Libgcrypt
  • Knowledge of low-level Linux cryptography APIs
  • Demonstrated ability to learn quickly
  • Performance engineering experience

What we offer you

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.

Job Duties

We are implementing a strict Medallion Architecture to organize petabytes of industrial data. This role is for a Data Engineer who excels at transforming raw chaos into structured, queryable assets.

You will build and maintain the ELT pipelines that move data from 'Bronze' (Raw) to 'Silver' (Cleaned) and 'Gold' (Aggregated). You will work with Delta Lake (On-prem/Databricks ), Polars and Airflow to ensure data quality and availability for Data Scientists and the Knowledge Graph.

  • Pipeline Development: Develop and maintain robust Airflow DAGs to orchestrate complex data transformations.
  • Data Transformation: Use Spark (when scale requires) and Polars to clean, enrich, and aggregate data according to business logic.
  • Architecture Implementation: Enforce the Medallion Architecture patterns, ensuring clear separation of concerns between data layers.
  • Performance Tuning: Optimize processing workflows (Polars/Spark) jobs and SQL queries to reduce costs and execution time; make intelligent decisions on when to use Polars vs. Spark.
  • Deployment & Operations: Manage code deployment to on-prem and cloud infrastructure, including containerization and environment configuration.
  • Data Quality: Implement comprehensive data validation checks and quality gates between medallion layers.
  • Data Cataloging: Maintain the metadata and catalog entries to ensure all data assets are discoverable and documented.

The Technology Stack

  • Orchestration: Apache Airflow.
  • Data Processing: Polars (primary for ETL), PySpark/SQL (for massive scale)
  • Compute : Single-node workers (Polars), Databricks/Spark clusters (when scale requires)
  • Storage: Delta Lake, Parquet, S3/Blob Storage, MinIO
  • Language: Python 3.12+ (w/ Polars), SQL.

Qualifications

  • Complete Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related.
  • 3+ years of experience in Data Engineering.
  • Strong proficiency in Apache Airflow and Databricks .
  • Experience implementing Medallion/Delta Lake architectures.

Good to Have:

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Quality Obsessive: You don\u2019t just move data; you test it. You implement checks to ensure no bad data reaches the Gold layer.
  • Pipeline Builder: You view data engineering as software engineering. You write modular, reusable code for your transformations.

title: Banco de Talentos (Técnico de Segurança do Trabalho)
description:
Banco de Talentos (Técnico de Segurança do Trabalho)

Join to apply for the Banco de Talentos (Técnico de Segurança do Trabalho) role at Triunfo Logística

Descrição

Acompanhar e/ou implementar os programas de segurança, proteção e meio ambiente, seguindo ou produzindo os seguintes processos: PPRA, CIPA, CAT, DDS e etc., fiscalizando e acompanhando o uso dos EPI´s, controlando a data de expiração dos equipamentos e materiais, elaborando relatórios fotográficos, além de palestras e integrações de novos funcionários.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Distribuir diariamente aos colaboradores, os EPI`s que serão usados, recolhendo aqueles danificados e separando-os, anotando na ficha pessoal de cada colaborador o que foi retirado e qual a data do trâmite, para fins de enviar uma notificação ao Auxiliar Administrativo para posterior compra, cumprimento da legislação e preservação da integridade física do colaborador. Fazer levantamento diário do estoque de todo o material de segurança do trabalho (entradas e saídas), anotando em planilha manual a relação dos materiais que faltam, repassando ao Administrativo, para fins de reposição de estoque. Visitar diariamente as áreas operacionais, para fins de inspecionar a segurança nas áreas. Fazer vistoria de veículos mensalmente, verificando pessoalmente os freios, faróis e etc., informando aos Terceirizados caso haja necessidade de algum reparo, lançando em planilha feita no Word os problemas relacionados ao veículo e enviando ao Gerente de Filial os problemas encontrados, para fins de manter os veículos em boas condições e segurança dos colaboradores. Fazer análise de risco baseando-se nas atividades que serão feitas pelas equipes, definindo qual será o EPI usado, qual o processo mais seguro para a realização da atividade, enumerando os possíveis riscos, para fins de preservar a integridade física dos colaboradores. Fazer diariamente a inspeção de segurança, especificando as não conformidades existentes nos locais, fazendo um relatório e encaminhando ao Gerente de Filial ou à empresa responsável, para fins de preservar a integridade física do colaborador e do Meio Ambiente. Responsável por elaborar todo trâmite relacionado à eleição da CIPA e os documentos da mesma, exigidos pelo Ministério do Trabalho e Emprego, para fins de atender a fiscalização trabalhista. Fazer cumprir as ações da CIPA em acordo com o SMS, identificar necessidades, planejar, executar e avaliar programas de treinamento de segurança industrial e meio ambiente; Controlar mensalmente o SESMT, número de acidentes ocorridos em cada setor, através de notificação do ocorrido, reunindo as CATS, análise de levantamento de acidentes, fazendo um parâmetro e calculando as horas perdidas, total de cada setor, enviando as cópias ao Gerente de Filial e a empresa CSN, para fins de controle do número de acidentes e as horas perdidas. Notificar eventualmente, através de comunicado feito em planilha Excel, uma análise do acidente ocorrido através de simulações ou depoimentos, traçando medidas corretivas, enviando ao Supervisor de área em que ocorreu o acidente, para fins de prevenir acidentes com a mesma proporção. Preencher eventualmente no site do INSS, uma CAT no prazo máximo de quarenta e oito horas após o acidente, informando a lesão ocorrida, o local e a hora, o agente causador, a situação causadora, imprimindo uma cópia e arquivando, fornecendo cópia ao colaborador, e enviando através do site do INSS, para fins de comunicar ao INSS, preservar o colaborador de possíveis dificuldades trabalhistas e a empresa de possíveis processos trabalhistas. Coordenar eventualmente a troca ou efetiva recarga de extintores, inspecionando um a um, mantendo contato direto com a empresa responsável pela manutenção dos extintores para fins da Triunfo estar preparada caso ocorra algum incêndio. Promover eventualmente a integração dos novos colaboradores, apresentando os riscos a que estão expostos, ensinando os procedimentos e análises de riscos, fazendo um treinamento total dos mesmos, apresentação através de Power Point, dando palestras em sala de reuniões, apresentando-os aos seus Supervisores, para fins de mostrar os riscos aos novos colaboradores, apresentar-lhes as responsabilidades e obrigações dentro da empresa. Elaborar mensalmente no Word, gerando cópias e distribuindo em locais de livre acesso aos colaboradores um jornal interno, imputando informações preventivas e atualidades, para fins de oferecer informações e gerar uma integração. Fiscalizar diariamente as Unidades, com o intuito de assegurar que o DDS (Diálogo Diário de Segurança) está sendo cumprido, arquivando e assinando o DDS, para fins de promover a conscientização e prevenção de acidentes entre os colaboradores. Preencher eventualmente uma planilha enviada pelo Porto de Itaguaí, constando a entrada e a saída de resíduos da oficina, entregando ao Chefe de Oficina, que é responsável pelo recolhimento, para fins de conformidades junto à FEEMA. Representar eventualmente, a empresa na CPATP (Comissão de Prevenção de Acidentes de Trabalhadores Portuários), participando de reuniões ordinárias e semestrais para fins de justificar problemas e tomar as devidas providências. Planejar, coordenar, orientar tecnicamente, avaliar e realizar estudos, avaliações e inspeções das condições de trabalho, quanto aos aspectos de higiene industrial, segurança industrial e meio ambiente, em áreas, equipamentos, instalações. Elaborar documentação necessária para a abertura da Comunicação de Acidente de Trabalho e encaminhar para o Setor de Recursos Humanos para que a mesma seja emitida. Orientar os membros da CIPA para os assuntos ligados a saúde e higiene, através da participação em reuniões e da realização de palestras na semana de prevenção da empresa, visando prevenir doenças e acidentes do trabalho. Indicar e orientar a implementação de medidas preventivas de segurança em toda área industrial, administrativa e proteção ao meio ambiente. Fazer cumprir as ações da CIPA em acordo com o SMS, identificar necessidades, planejar, executar e avaliar programas de treinamento de segurança industrial e meio ambiente. Fazer plano de ação para cumprimento do Anexo SMS escopo do Contrato, apresentando evidências para PETROBRAS. Participar de programas de auditorias de SMS, segurança industrial e de meio ambiente, acompanhar as atividades operacionais nas áreas contratuais, visando à segurança do profissional envolvido, bem patrimonial e meio ambiente Investigar a analisar acidentes e ocorrências anormais, planejando e executando Plano de Ação trazendo segurança nas operações. Elaborar planos de contingência e coordenar atividades de controle de emergências para todas as áreas contratuais, proceder de acordo com os padrões técnicos e normas operacionais.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Formação técnica em Segurança do Trabalho
  • Registro no MTE
  • Conhecimento em legislação de segurança do trabalho e normas regulamentadoras (NR)
  • Bons conhecimentos em informática e ferramentas de gestão
  • Habilidade de comunicação e interação com equipes
  • Conhecimento em primeiros socorros

Overview

We are seeking a Protection & Control Engineer to join the Technical Services Division. The Technical Services Division is responsible for providing and managing highly technical and specialized engineering services to support safe, reliable, and efficient operation of Saudi Aramco’s electrical transmission and distribution networks. The Division also provides services in power system protection, control, and advanced system studies to ensure asset integrity, personnel safety, and continuity of power supply. Your primary role is to provide specialized technical support services related to protection system design, relay settings, system modeling, and power system studies. Your role also includes ownership and governance of power system models, supporting standardization, data integrity, and continuous improvement across projects and operations.

Key Responsibilities

As the successful candidate, you will be required to perform the following:

  • Conduct protection relay settings calculations, coordination reviews, and verification for transmission, distribution, and industrial power systems.
  • Lead or support power system disturbance and interruption investigations, including relay event analysis, fault reconstruction, and root cause analysis.
  • Provide technical review for protection philosophies, relay settings files, system study reports, and engineering deliverables.
  • Review, support development, and update company standards, guidelines, and procedures related to protection, control, and power system studies.
  • Perform and validate load flow, short-circuit, protection coordination, arc flash, and transient stability studies using Electrical Transient Analyzer Program (ETAP).
  • Perform arc flash hazard analyses and support mitigation strategies in accordance with IEEE, NFPA, and Saudi Aramco standards.
  • Conduct transient and electromagnetic studies (e.g., switching transients, motor starting, system response) using ETAP and PSCAD.
  • Support commissioning, site testing, troubleshooting, and post-event analysis of protection and control systems.
  • Develop, maintain, and govern ETAP power system models, ensuring accuracy, consistency, version control, and alignment across projects, operations, and studies.
  • Provide technical consultation to operations and maintenance teams to enhance system reliability, selectivity, and resilience.
  • Support digitalization and continuous improvement initiatives related to protection systems, power system modeling, analytics, and engineering workflows.
  • Interface with vendors, consultants, and contractors to ensure compliance with Saudi Aramco Engineering Standards and international codes.
  • Represent the organization in industry forums, technical committees, and professional working groups related to power system protection and analysis.
  • Prepare high-quality technical reports, presentations, and knowledge-sharing materials.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentoring where required.
  • As the successful candidate, you will hold a Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering from an accredited university. An advanced degree is a plus.
  • You will have a minimum of 10 years’ experience in power system protection and control, with direct involvement in system studies, relay settings, and operational investigations within oil & gas, utilities, industrial facilities, or equipment manufacturers.
  • You will have a background in protection of transformers, motors, transmission lines, and distribution systems.
  • You will be able to demonstrate advanced proficiency in ETAP, including model governance and execution of Load flow, Short-circuit, rotation coordination, Arc flash analysis, and Transient and dynamic studies.
  • You will have a practical experience using PSCAD for electromagnetic transient (EMT) and complex system behavior analysis.
  • You will have a knowledge of ANSI and IEC protection philosophies, relay technologies, and control schemes.
  • You will be familiar with IEEE, IEC, NFPA, and Saudi Aramco Engineering Standards (SAES).
  • You will have capability in power system event analysis, fault investigations, and root cause analysis.
  • You will have strong analytical, problem-solving, and technical communication skills.
  • Professional Engineering (PE) certifications or equivalent is a plus.

title: Brazil - Remote: Back-end Developer
description:
Select how often (in days) to receive an alert:

We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.

Job Duties

We are building a platform that merges real-time physics, structured knowledge, and autonomous intelligence. We are looking for developers ready to tackle one (or more) of those challenges:

  • Ingestion: Handling massive streams of sensor data with minimal latency.
  • Intelligence: Making LLMs deterministic and reliable within robust multi-agent systems.
  • Context: Modeling complex ontologies to map thousands of physical assets.

What You’ll Do

You will join a high-performance team, contributing to the Core Backend while focusing on one of the following distinct tracks:

Core Responsibilities

  • High-Performance APIs: Build low-latency Python services (FastAPI) to serve live data to frontend and AI models.
  • System Reliability: Debug complex concurrency issues and ensure production reliability in distributed systems.
  • Rapid Delivery: Adopt a "deliver fast" mentality without compromising on code quality, testing, or API design standards.

Possible paths to work on the Project (you can contribute to one or more):

Streaming & High-Throughput Data

  • Build Streaming Pipelines: Design scalable services using Kafka and Spark/Flink to process raw sensor data in real-time.
  • Time-Series Optimization: Optimize database schemas (TimescaleDB) to enable fast historical data retrieval and implement algorithmic checks to validate sensor readings.

GenAI & Autonomous Agents

  • Build Autonomous Agents: Deploy stateful agents (using LangGraph) that plan tasks, query Knowledge Graphs, and execute tools without hallucinating.
  • Advanced RAG: Build Graph-RAG pipelines that combine semantic search with structured knowledge traversal for grounded answers
  • Knowledge Graph Engineering: Design domain ontologies in Neo4j, defining relationships between assets, documents, and time-series data.
  • Search Infrastructure: Implement Hybrid Retrieval logic combining Vector Search, Full-Text Search, and Graph traversal.

Qualifications

Must Haves:

Complete Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related.

  • 5+ years of experience in Python Backend development.
  • Advanced English communication skills.
  • Computer Science fundamentals: Data Structures and Algorithms.
  • Strong experience building and documenting REST APIs (FastAPI).

Good to Have:

  • Streaming: Proficiency with Streaming Technologies (Kafka, Flink, Spark) and Time-Series Databases (TimescaleDB, InfluxDB).
  • GenAI: Practical experience building applications with LLMs, Agentic Frameworks (LangGraph), and Vector Databases.
  • Graph: Hands-on experience with Graph Databases (Neo4j/Cypher), SQL database design, and Hybrid Search strategies
  • Background in Heavy Industry, O&G, or IoT data (MQTT, OPC UA).
  • Experience with Local LLMs (Ollama) for privacy-focused deployments.
  • Familiarity with Data Lineage or Metadata management.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

We use a modern, high-performance stack. You should be proficient in the Core and deeply knowledgeable in your chosen track.

Desired Profile

  • Problem Solver: You dig into logs to find the root cause of a data spike, a silent failure, or a disconnected node in a graph.
  • Modern Pythonista: You are up-to-date with modern Python async patterns and typing, ensuring code is high-performance and maintainable.
  • You understand Big O notation and how to optimize code for CPU/memory efficiency.

About the project:

As a Staff Site Reliability Engineer , you will own and optimize OpenTelemetry pipelines, enabling scalable and efficient observability. You’ll build tools that empower teams, support incident response, and drive best practices. Your work ensures a reliable, secure infrastructure and actionable alerting across the organization.

How your day-to-day work will look like

Design, implement, and maintain observability pipelines across the three main signals—logs, metrics, and traces—ensuring standardized, scalable, and efficient data ingestion. Optimize ingestion strategies to balance cost, performance, and usability.

Build self-service automation and tooling that enables development teams to instrument and leverage observability without requiring manual intervention from the SRE team. Drive adoption of best practices while ensuring teams own their telemetry.

Design the processes, playbooks, checklists, and automations for them and other engineers to follow during an incident.

Interact with members from almost all teams across the business to understand their monitoring, alerting, and SLO / SLA requirements and design systems and processes that ensure we meet or exceed these requirements. Influence architectural decisions during initial design stages to ensure resiliency and scale at the outset of software development.

Design the processes, playbooks, checklists, and automations for them and other engineers to follow during an incident.

Leverage Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) to provision and manage monitoring tools, alerting rules, and our observability configurations across OTEL Pipelines.

Design base-level requirements for new and existing services to ensure that all client infrastructure and code are monitored consistently and accurately at a basic level.

Take full ownership of client infrastructure reliability, ensuring adherence to key availability and security KPIs.

This would make you the ideal candidate

Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

8+ Years of experience working as an SRE Engineer or in a very similar role, more focused on observability.

5+ Years of experience working with cloud (AWS).

5+ Years of experience working with IaC tools (Terraform) and GitOps CI/CD solutions (ArgoCD, GitHub Actions, or similar).

4+ Years of experience working with monitoring and logging tools such as Grafana, Prometheus, Loki, New Relic, or Datadog (experience managing observability pipelines at scale in high-throughput environments).

4+ Years of experience working in Kubernetes, including its core components, deployment methodologies, and monitoring best practices.

Strong communication skills with team members and stakeholders (technical and nontechnical communication).

Strong scripting abilities (Python, Go, or similar) for automating observability tasks.

Experience integrating incident management platforms (PagerDuty, Jira) with automated alerting workflows.

Advanced English Level is required for this role as you will work with US clients. Effective communication in English is essential to deliver the best solutions to our clients and expand your horizons.

Overview

Apply here if you believe you possess outstanding revenue generating experience from the Technology industry.

About Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

Roles

As we continue to grow we are looking to hire both Enterprise Sales and Alliances Sales representatives to drive revenue growth and meet our goals. Our Alliances Sales Directors own a book of business helping to enable Canonical to work with its go to market partners, hardware vendors, software vendors, solutions integrators and distributors and channels. With a fast growing channel business, GSI/SI and Hardware partners, we need to enable, manage and grow business opportunities and drive market expansion alongside revenue growth. Reporting to the Alliances leadership, you will be working with direct sales, marketing, product, customer success, finance, legal and support as you demonstrate thought leadership, practical skills, and apply your knowledge and experience to help us grow in this critical area. Our Enterprise Sales Executives own the relationships with our direct customers and are responsible for maintaining and growing relationships that result in mutually beneficial engagements. They help craft solutions that enable our customers to be more efficient, solve more complex problems and walk the path with the customer to get the best possible results. Reporting to Sales leadership, you will work across either a region or a vertical and you can bring your knowledge of previous customers with you. We are committed to giving customers the most knowledgeable and most competent partners in sales so that we can succeed together.

Location: We have remote opportunities available globally. This link in particular is for a Spanish Speaker based in or able to easily commute to Colombia. A good knowledge of the Colombian market is mandatory.

These roles entail

  • Advancing a deep understanding of Linux and cloud software ecosystem, and open source selling models

  • Leading executive interlocks between partners/customers and our own leadership team

What we are looking for in you

  • Track record of going above-and-beyond expectations to achieve revenue outstanding results in our technological field
  • Experience with Linux and opensource
  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university, regardless of seniority of current position
  • Undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path
  • Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, and share ideas without hesitation
  • Leadership and commitment to skills development and mentorship
  • Passion for technology evidenced by personal projects and initiatives
  • The work ethic and confidence to shine alongside motivated colleagues
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Appreciative of diversity, polite and effective in a multi-cultural, multi-national organisation
  • Thoughtfulness and self-motivation with results orientated mind set and a high level of personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long and more regularly to meet clients and partners as required

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Program including Health and Wellness platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Job description

SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas, Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Main responsibilities

Centro Especializado de Estímulo ao Desenvolvimento Infantil - Reabilitação Intelectual e TEA (CEEDI) é um serviço cuja proposta é rever e transformar a lógica do capacitismo e oportunizar o diagnóstico qualificado em tempo oportuno, por meio de um modelo de serviço que incorpore a avaliação especializada para o diagnóstico diferencial, estimulação precoce, com equipe multidisciplinar para processo de re/habilitação, envolvendo a rede de apoio no processo e projeto terapêutico.

Trata-se de um centro de reabilitação, modalidade reabilitação intelectual, com ações e serviços voltados para avaliar, desenvolver ou ampliar a capacidade funcional para o desenvolvimento pleno das crianças e adolescentes com deficiência intelectual, transtornos globais de desenvolvimento, transtorno do espectro autista, investindo em iniciativas que trabalhem potencialidades, talentos, habilidades e aptidões físicas, cognitivas, sensoriais, psicossociais, atitudinais, profissionais e artísticas, para a autonomia e participação cidadã em igualdade de condições e oportunidades com as demais pessoas. A habilitação/reabilitação prevê uma abordagem interdisciplinar e o envolvimento direto de profissionais, cuidadores e familiares/ parceiros nos processos de cuidado.

O profissional, terá a função de realizar o seguimento das crianças com alterações nos marcos do desenvolvimento, contemplando a avaliação longitudinal com o objetivo de elucidação diagnóstica, início precoce da estimulação precoce e orientação dos familiares e responsáveis.

Requirements and skills

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Medicina com registro ativo no Conselho da Classe
  • Registro de especialista em Psiquiatria (RQE)
  • Desejável pós-graduação em uma ou mais das áreas citadas a seguir: Saúde Mental; TEA; Saúde da Família; Saúde Pública; Saúde Coletiva
  • Registro ativo no Conselho da Classe
  • Desejável experiência com TEA (Transtorno do Espectro Autista na infância e adolescência)

Additional information

  • Carga Horária: 40h/20h semanais
  • Local de atuação: AP 3.3 (Madureira e Adjacências)

Descrição da vaga

Buscamos um Especialista em Prompt Engineering / Conversacional para atuar na construção, otimização e evolução de soluções baseadas em modelos de linguagem (LLMs). Este profissional será responsável por ajustar o comportamento da IA, criar fluxos conversacionais de alta qualidade e garantir respostas seguras, claras e alinhadas ao contexto de negócio.

O papel é essencial para transformar LLMs em soluções práticas e confiáveis, reduzindo erros, melhorando precisão e permitindo que a IA resolva tarefas complexas de forma eficiente.

A nossa empresa é feita por gente. Nós já fazemos parte do seu dia. Agora, queremos que você faça parte do nosso dia a dia.

Traga a sua energia para aLight !

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Seus desafios serão:

  • Desenvolver prompts avançados, few-shot examples, cadeias de raciocínio e comportamentos específicos para agentes de IA.
  • Criar fluxos conversacionais claros, estruturados e consistentes para diversos casos de uso.
  • Ajustar o comportamento de LLMs para maximizar precisão, reduzir alucinações e melhorar segurança.
  • Trabalhar com técnicas modernas como RAG, prompt tuning, embeddings e context augmentation.
  • Propor e testar abordagens para melhorar a qualidade das respostas — métricas, benchmarks e controles.

Requisitos e qualificações

O que é necessário você ter:

  • Ensino superior completo em áreas de TI.
  • Experiência com LLMs (GPT, LLaMA, Claude, Mistral, etc.).
  • Domínio de técnicas de prompt engineering, incluindo:
  • prompts estruturados
  • chains e agentes
  • system prompts, role prompting
  • técnicas de redução de alucinação
  • Conhecimento de NLP, embeddings e frameworks como LangChain, LlamaIndex ou equivalentes.
  • Boa habilidade de escrita — clareza, precisão, lógica e consistência são essenciais.
  • Experiência com Python para testes e automação de fluxos conversacionais.

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com RAG, fine-tuning leve (LoRA) e avaliação automática de respostas.
  • Conhecimento de UX conversacional.
  • Projetos anteriores com agentes autônomos, copilots corporativos ou chatbots avançados.
  • Capacidade de prototipar rapidamente soluções e validar conceitos.

A Recruiter is responsible for identifying, attracting, and hiring top talent to meet an organization’s staffing needs, ensuring that each hire aligns with both the technical requirements and the cultural values of the company. This role involves proactively sourcing candidates through a variety of channels, including job boards, professional networks, social media platforms, recruitment agencies, industry events, and employee referrals.

Once potential candidates are identified, the Recruiter screens applications, conducts initial assessments, and manages interview processes to evaluate skills, experience, and fit. They work closely with hiring managers to define job requirements, craft compelling job descriptions, and establish selection criteria that lead to strong matches.

The role extends beyond simply filling positions—it also involves managing the entire recruitment lifecycle from initial contact to offer negotiation and onboarding. This includes coordinating interviews, providing feedback to candidates, ensuring timely communication, and guiding both candidates and hiring teams through each stage of the process. A strong focus on candidate experience is key, as positive interactions contribute to the employer’s brand and long-term talent pipeline.

In many cases, Recruiters also track and analyze hiring metrics—such as time-to-fill, cost-per-hire, and source effectiveness—to refine strategies and improve overall recruitment efficiency. They stay informed about labor market trends, competitive compensation data, and evolving recruitment technologies, adapting approaches to remain competitive in attracting top talent.

To excel, a Recruiter must combine exceptional communication and interpersonal skills with strategic thinking, organization, and relationship-building capabilities. Their work plays a critical role in shaping the company’s workforce, influencing its ability to grow, innovate, and succeed.

title: Engineering Manager, MAAS
description:
Overview

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in more than 80 countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

We are hiring an Engineering Manager as we expand the MAAS team . Our mission with MAAS ("Metal as a Service") is to provide the best solution for building and running private bare-metal infrastructure, putting a cloud-style on-demand API in front of physical server provisioning, network configuration, and storage. We are hiring engineering managers with experience in high-quality software development and high-performance team leadership who also have deep familiarity with Linux on physical servers, Linux storage and data center networking capabilities.

The Canonical MAAS team is responsible for delivering our Metal As A Service (MAAS) hyperscale provisioning technology. Ubuntu strives to be the most scalable, cloud ready server distribution and MAAS is our platform to get Ubuntu on bare metal servers. MAAS is a rapidly evolving software stack written in Python and Go. Its components span the entire software stack: from low-level hardware detection and provisioning, to the upper level management web interface, API, and CLI. Our most effective engineers are fluent in all these layers, and able to anticipate the consequences of design and engineering choices elsewhere in a complex distributed system.

Canonical is seeking passionate technical leaders who are eager to drive innovation in one of Canonical's flagship data center products. You will play a key role in reshaping the future of data center technology through open source management platforms. MAAS aims to revolutionize data center management at scale starting from day zero deployment to long term data center expansion and maintenance.

Technical leadership experience and a background in software engineering are necessary prerequisites for this role. You will be expected to lead, challenge, and develop engineers, positively influence team and company culture, facilitate technical delivery, and guide strategy and execution. In addition to these responsibilities, you will be expected to collaborate across engineering. The MAAS team regularly interfaces with teams responsible for cloud-init, LXD, and our public cloud offerings.

The successful candidate will have technical leadership attributes and can demonstrate the ability to solve challenging distributed systems problems.

Location : This is a work-from-anywhere position available in EMEA or the Americas.

What we are looking for in you

  • Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) and a background in Computer Science
  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Proven experience delivering software using Python, Golang, or similar languages
  • Experience with Linux system administration (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)
  • Familiarity with modern Linux cloud computing technologies, including networking, storage, containers and K8S
  • Technical aptitude for understanding complex distributed systems
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills
  • Experience with agile software development methodologies
  • Ability to mentor, develop, and support team members
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long

Nice-to-have skills

  • Typescript using modern web frameworks such as React, Angular, Svelte or Vue
  • Data Center infrastructure management and design

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person - we\'ve been working remotely since 2004!
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

description:
Support the design, development, and maintenance of master data models that ensure the accuracy and consistency of key business data across systems. Collaborate with senior team members to model data structures and optimize data flow, supporting various departments such as finance, sales, and operations. This position is ideal for someone with a passion for data modeling, a keen eye for detail, and a desire to grow in data management and governance.

Duties and Responsibilities

  • Assist in the design and development of master data models for master domains such as customer, assets, supplier, and financial data.
  • Help create and maintain data models (conceptual, logical, and physical) that align with business needs and data governance policies.
  • Ensure the accuracy and integrity of master data by supporting data modeling standards and best practices.
  • Analyze data from various sources to support data modeling decisions and validate the accuracy and completeness of master data.
  • Perform basic data profiling and quality checks to identify patterns, anomalies, and potential improvements in data structures.
  • Collaborate with data quality and data governance teams to ensure consistency across systems.
  • Assist in designing data flow diagrams and documenting data mappings between different systems.
  • Work with data engineers and system architects to integrate master data models with existing databases and applications.
  • Support the creation of data management workflows that optimize data retrieval, storage, and reporting processes.
  • Help maintain documentation for master data models, including data definitions, relationships, and lineage.
  • Prepare reports and presentations on data modeling findings and recommendations to stakeholders and team members.
  • Contribute to the development of metadata repositories and data dictionaries to support enterprise data governance.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in data management, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • Relevant coursework or project experience in data modeling, databases, or data management is a plus.
  • Basic understanding of data modeling concepts (e.g., entity-relationship models, dimensional modeling) and database structures.
  • Familiarity with data modeling tools such as Erwin, IBM InfoSphere Data Architect, SAP PowerDesigner, or similar tools.
  • Proficiency in SQL for querying databases and understanding relational data structures.
  • Some exposure to data governance principles, master data management (MDM), and data integration processes.

Desired Qualifications

  • Experience working with relational database management systems (RDBMS) such as Oracle, SQL Server, or MySQL.
  • Familiarity with metadata management and data dictionary tools is a plus.

Principais atividades

  • Visitar os clientes da sua carteira (fábricas e escritórios), atuando no planejamento estratégico de visitas, visando cobrir a região estabelecida.
  • Atuar em conjunto com time de engenharia de aplicação do distribuidor local para que possam fazer análises e proposições técnicas para resoluções de problemas e/ou implantações de novos projetos em clientes.

  • Acompanhar quando necessário em cooperação com o nosso distribuidor local, a elaboração dos orçamentos e relatórios técnicos de produtos de acordo com a necessidade dos clientes, visando assegurar diferencial competitivo ao negócio.
  • Registrar as informações relacionadas às oportunidades de negócios no sistema de CRM, assegurando que todos os dados sejam precisos e atualizados.
  • Manter os cadastros dos clientes sempre atualizados, garantindo a integridade e a qualidade das informações disponíveis para a equipe e para a tomada de decisões estratégicas.
  • Converter as visitas aos clientes em vendas, colaborando com o atingimento do plano de meta de vendas estabelecida pela companhia.
  • Acompanhar o faturamento de materiais, com o auxílio do relatório de backlog do sistema e alinhamento com a fábrica, com a finalidade de cumprir com o prazo de entrega acordado com o cliente e atingir a meta de faturamento.
  • Manter relacionamento com o cliente como parte da estratégia de vendas e gestão comercial, provendo suporte com informações de data de entrega, faturamento, instalação e start-up dos materiais, assegurando o devido funcionamento e desempenho dos mesmos.
  • Definição e participação em atividades orientadas ao mercado, como feiras, palestras e eventos corporativos.

Qualificações Necessárias

  • 3 anos de experiência com vendas técnicas.
  • Ensino superior em Engenharia Mecânica, Mecatrônica, Química ou Técnico em Mecânica.
  • Conhecimento em processos industriais, especialmente nos segmentos químico e petroquímico.
  • Diferencial possuir noções sobre sistemas de vapor e automação/instrumentação.
  • Vivência em gestão de contas.
  • Experiência com Técnicas de Negociação.
  • Capacidade analítica para identificar oportunidades de negócio a partir de dados.
  • Disponibilidade para viagens.
  • Inglês intermediário.

Sobre o Grupo Spirax

O negócio de Soluções Térmicas a Vapor é um dos três negócios do Grupo Spirax. A Spirax Sarco e a Gestra são nossas duas marcas que formam a Steam Thermal Solutions e são líderes globais no fornecimento de soluções de engenharia para o projeto, fornecimento e manutenção de sistemas de vapor industriais e comerciais eficientes. A Steam Thermal Solutions tem cobertura global em 67 unidades operacionais (chamadas OpCos), organizadas em quatro divisões: EMEA, APAC, Américas e Gestra.

O Spirax Group é um grupo multinacional de engenharia industrial FTSE100 e FTSE4Good, especializado no controle e gerenciamento de vapor, soluções térmicas elétricas, bombeamento peristáltico e tecnologias de fluidos associadas.

Nosso objetivo é criar valor sustentável para todos os nossos acionistas à medida que projetamos um mundo mais eficiente, seguro e sustentável. Nossas tecnologias desempenham um papel essencial em processos industriais críticos e equipamentos industriais em setores tão diversos como Alimentos e Bebidas, Farmacêutico e Biotecnologia, Geração de Energia, Semicondutores e Saúde. Com clientes em 165 países, fornecemos as soluções que estão por trás da produção de muitos itens usados na vida cotidiana, de feijões cozidos a telefones celulares!

Nenhum restante de nosso Propósito, apoiado por nossa cultura e valores inclusivos, nos une, orienta nossas decisões e nos inspira em todos os lugares em que atuamos. Apoiamos nossos colegas para que façam a diferença uns para os outros, bem como para clientes, comunidades, fornecedores, nosso planeta e acionistas, criando um ambiente de trabalho verdadeiramente equitativo, onde todos se sintam incluídos.

Todos estão incluídos no Grupo Spirax

Somos apaixonados pela criação de culturas de trabalho inclusivas e equitativas, onde todos possam ser eles mesmos e atingir seu pleno potencial. Para nós, isso significa equipes de apoio e relacionamentos sólidos em que a contribuição de todos é valorizada - em todas as origens sociais e culturais, etnias, idades, gêneros, identidades de gênero, habilidades, neurodiversidade, orientação sexual, crenças religiosas e tudo o mais que nos torna humanos e únicos.

Sabemos que todo mundo também precisa de ajuda extra de vez em quando, por isso introduzimos uma série de benefícios adicionais por meio de nossos Compromissos de Inclusão do Grupo. Esses benefícios incluem licença parental de gênero neutro, 15 dias de licença remunerada extra para cuidadores, folga remunerada e apoio a qualquer pessoa que esteja passando por perda de gravidez ou abuso doméstico, princípios de local de trabalho favorável à menopausa e muito mais. title: Venue Telecom Manager
description:
Venue Telecom Manager

Department: Technology

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

Reporting organizationally to the Senior Telecoms Manager, the Venue Telecom Manager (VTCM) will be a key member of the FIFA27 Technology team. The VTCM will work closely with the Technology teams in all the stadiums and IBCC and Zurich, as well as other stakeholders, to deliver critical Network and telecommunications solutions for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Manage the planning, delivery, and operations of telecommunications infrastructure and services across competition and non-competition venues, including:
  • Broadcast Contribution Network (BCN)
  • Event Network (WAN, MAN, LAN, WLAN, cabling, containment)
  • Internet, VLAN, VPN services, VoIP
  • Mobile Network and Private 5G
  • Push-to-Talk/Private Mobile Radios
  • Spectrum Management
  • CATV/IPTV
  • Rate Card services (Internet/IP Codecs)
  • Deploy and oversee technology services across various venues.
  • Stadia, training sites, operation centers, accreditation centers, ticketing centers, hotels, airports, and transport hubs.
  • Ensure compliance with FIFA standards in the integration of tournament technology services, such as Accreditation and Ticketing, with the FIFA Event Network environment.
  • Collaborate with Football Technology Innovation suppliers, media, broadcasters, and other functional stakeholders to define and fulfill network and cybersecurity requirements.
  • Coordinate on-site IT and telecom technical teams for infrastructure testing, acceptance, and operations.
  • Manage incident resolution and ensure adherence to service-level agreements (SLAs), escalating risks and issues to the Technology Command Center (TCC).
  • Support spectrum management efforts, including interference resolution in collaboration with regulatory authorities and venue teams.
  • Ensure timely and accurate reporting, including daily updates to the TCC and post-event analysis.
  • Participate in pre-tournament training, readiness exercises, and rehearsals.

YOUR PROFILE

Education

  • University degree or similar higher education, in Information Technology, Computer Science, Telecommunications Engineering or related field

Experience

  • Minimum of 5 years of IT/Technology experience, preferably in major events.
  • Strong knowledge of IT and telecommunications technologies, including CATV, AV systems, radio communications, VLANs and related areas.
  • Experience coordinating with diverse teams and managing vendor relationships.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills.
  • Detail-oriented and process-driven with the ability to manage competing priorities.
  • Effective communicator with strong interpersonal skills.
  • Prior experience in the Sports / major event industry is highly preferred

Skills & Competencies

  • Manager with experience in similar projects
  • Good knowledge of venue technology services across major sporting events
  • Have up to date knowledge and project management expertise in all event related technologies, including, all types of technology business solutions, community access TV (CATV), radio communications, wired communication, printing, broadcast contribution network, spectrum, audio and visual.
  • Ability to always maintain a professional demeanour. Consistently interacts professionally and works productively with all levels of employee.
  • Excellent cross group collaboration skills and demonstrated ability to lead virtual teams across groups, conflict management and driving consensus to deliver on program milestones
  • Good Leadership skills and able to manage and motivate other team members
  • Highly adept at consulting, negotiating, communicating, consensus building and facilitation
  • Excellent verbal and written communication, training, and presentation skills
  • Ability to adapt speech to audience coming from a broad spectrum of disciplines and with various levels of technical knowledge
  • Leadership and accountability across all areas of relevance
  • Strong political acumen and adaptable to a wide range of working environments

Certifications & Requirements

  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Fluent in English
  • Native or Fluent in Portuguese
  • Proficiency in any other FIFA language (FR / ES / GER) is an asset

Various

  • Ability to relocate to Rio de Janeiro
  • Willing to travel within Brazil (up to 30%), with some trips with a long duration (15 days or more)

O nosso propósito é entregar saúde! Se você é inconformado, protagonista da sua carreira e busca a excelência continuamente para encantar seus clientes, essa é a sua oportunidade!

Conheça os principais desafios e responsabilidades da função:

  • Realizar visitas técnicas, reuniões de briefing e alinhamento com clientes internos, agências e fornecedores;

GESTÃO DE ORÇAMENTOS

DIVULGAÇÃO E COMUNICAÇÃO DE EVENTOS

Fundado em 1961 com a criação da Profarma Distribuição, o Grupo Profarma consolidou-se como um dos líderes no mercado farmacêutico brasileiro, ocupando hoje uma relevante atuação no mercado nacional em distribuição. Afinal, entregar saúde é o nosso propósito.

Diversidade e Inclusão no Grupo Profarma

Field Compliance Coordinator - Relocate to Saudi Arabia, Permanent Expat Relocation Package

Position : Field Compliance Coordinator with full relocation to Saudi Arabia as a permanent full‑time expatriate. Attractive relocation package. Qualified candidates will be contacted.

Position Description

We are seeking a Field Compliance Coordinator to join our Upstream OE & Compliance Division. The Division is responsible for providing safety support to Upstream Executive Management and various organizations through HSE reporting, safety audits, recommendations, human‑factor guidance, training, major incident investigations, and lessons‑learned creation. Your primary role will support upstream organizations on Process Safety and major incident investigations for onshore and offshore drilling and oil & gas processing plants.

Key Responsibilities

  • Enhance safety standards and procedures such as work permits, process safety, hazard identification, risk management, and emergency preparedness.
  • Develop loss‑prevention, fire‑prevention, and safety standards, procedures, and General Instructions (GIs) for matters not covered by existing resources.
  • Consult with upstream management to facilitate Safety Management System (SMS) enhancement.
  • Create critical safety documents for major activities such as job safety analyses and hazard identification plans.
  • Assist departments in preparing for major safety reviews, including loss‑prevention compliance reviews.
  • Research emerging safety technologies and conduct feasibility studies and cost analyses to identify improved solutions for existing safety problems and regulatory requirements.
  • Act as a process‑safety audit expert during design, construction, commissioning, turnover to operations, ongoing operations, change management, and decommissioning.
  • Develop and deliver safety training material and safe‑work procedures to field personnel.
  • Instruct on safety concepts, practices, and standards (both on‑the‑job and classroom).
  • Direct and participate in preparing major reference manuals documenting corporate and LP safety systems, policies, and procedures (e.g., LP Policy, SMS manual, Safety Handbook, Construction Safety Manual).
  • Facilitate and lead incident investigations, including interviewing witnesses, gathering data, and conducting root‑cause analysis.
  • Facilitate and lead safety audits by identifying non‑compliance with occupational health and safety regulations and advising on improvements.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, HSE, or an equivalent accredited program.
  • Minimum of 10 years of experience in upstream organizations spanning exploration, drilling, and production on both onshore and offshore sites, with at least 5 years in a senior loss‑prevention or fire‑prevention role.
  • Strong technical expertise in process safety disciplines such as design engineering, loss control management, hazard identification, HAZOP reviews, incident investigations, emergency preparedness, response, and safety management systems.
  • Experience with HAZOP and SIL studies is preferred; internationally recognized certifications are advantageous.

Working Environment

Our high‑performing employees are drawn by challenging and rewarding professional, technical, and industrial opportunities, and are remunerated accordingly.

Benefits

Permanent expatriate relocation package, competitive compensation, and opportunities for career development within a global energy leader.

description:
O Grupo Granado abre as portas para você!

Estamos em busca de um Analista de Desenvolvimento de Produto Sênior para fazer parte da nossa equipe. Se você é uma pessoa organizada, dinâmica e comprometida, esta pode ser a oportunidade perfeita para você. Como Analista de Desenvolvimento de Produto Sênior, você será responsável pelo planejamento, desenvolvimento e aprimoramento de produtos das marcas do Grupo Granado, atuando desde a concepção e viabilidade do projeto até o acompanhamento pós lançamento, com interface entre diversas áreas.

  • Planejar e implementar a estratégia de desenvolvimento de produtos, alinhada à visão e objetivos da empresa.
  • Gerenciar todo o ciclo de vida do produto, da concepção ao lançamento, incluindo pesquisas, protótipos, testes e validações.
  • Liderar projetos de desenvolvimento, garantindo alinhamento entre design, engenharia, produção, marketing e qualidade.
  • Realizar pesquisas de mercado e análise da concorrência para identificar tendências e oportunidades de diferenciação.
  • Controlar cronogramas, marcos, prazos e riscos, implementando ações corretivas quando necessário.
  • Aprovar briefings, fórmulas, fragrâncias e produtos pilots, assegurando qualidade e aderência ao conceito.
  • Gerir orçamento de projetos, otimizando recursos e garantindo eficiência financeira.
  • Orientar a equipe de marketing em estratégias de lançamento e comunicação de produtos.
  • Monitorar o desempenho pós-lançamento, analisando indicadores de vendas, feedback de clientes e concorrência.
  • Apoiar a equipe de vendas com treinamentos, apresentações e materiais de produtos.
  • Criar e validar materiais e textos de marketing, além de elaborar apresentações e treinamentos de produtos.
  • Superior completo em Comunicação, Administração, Marketing ou áreas correlatas.
  • Conhecimento em produtos cosméticos (profissional e/ou pessoal).
  • Inglês avançado
  • Análise de dados e indicadores.
  • Pacote Office Avançado.
  • Comunicação clara e colaborativa
  • Gestão de projetos e organização
  • Orientação para resultados
  • Bom relacionamento interpessoal e trabalho em equipe
  • Visão estratégica
  • Planejamento e criatividade

O que você encontra por aqui:

  • Ambiente integrado, alegre e positivo , onde a colaboração faz parte da rotina.
  • Horário flexível , para você fugir do trânsito e aproveitar melhor o seu tempo.
  • Vale-Refeição para curtir bons momentos e conversas descontraídas enquanto saboreia suas refeições.
  • Plano de saúde, odontológico e seguro de vida , porque cuidar de você e da sua família é prioridade. Afinal, mente sã em corpo são é o que importa!
  • Total Pass , para manter o corpo em movimento e a energia sempre lá em cima.
  • Descontos exclusivos nos produtos que você já ama: Granado, Phebo e Care Natural Beauty.
  • Ambiente que estimula a criatividade e o aprendizado contínuo , com apoio ao seu desenvolvimento por meio do nosso Programa de Educação Continuada — incluindo subsídios para cursos de aperfeiçoamento, graduação, pós-graduação e idiomas.
  • Parcerias com instituições de ensino e idiomas , como Estácio e Open English, para facilitar ainda mais sua jornada de desenvolvimento.
  • Programa de Participação nos Resultados , valorizando quem cresce e constrói junto com a gente.

É muita história para contar...

Desde o século XIX a Granado atravessa gerações encantando seus consumidores com produtos de qualidade e com uma pegada sustentável. São mais de 150 anos e, desde sua fundação, a marca sempre soube manter valores sólidos e estar atenta às necessidades de seu tempo. Cresceu e rejuvenesceu sem perder a essência.

Em 1930, a Perfumaria Phebo foi fundada em Belém do Pará, com fragrâncias marcantes, originais e de alta qualidade. Esta tradição, aliada ao seu conhecimento, ousadia e personalidade forte, alçou a Phebo ao topo das marcas de cosméticos mais respeitadas do mercado brasileiro, tornando-se sinônimo de luxo, excelência olfativa e qualidade.

Com uma proposta que valoriza o equilíbrio e o consumo consciente, em 2024 a CARE se uniu à Granado e à Phebo para oferecer uma experiência de autocuidado transformadora, integrando ciência, tecnologia e sustentabilidade.

Nossa rica história centenária ajuda a construir um futuro inovador. Estamos presentes em cada produto desenvolvido; em cada loja inaugurada no Brasil e no exterior; em cada embalagem diferenciada e em cada olhar comprometido com o bem-estar das pessoas, com a segurança no local de trabalho e com a preservação do meio ambiente.

Juntas, Granado, Phebo e CARE representam a harmonia entre história e futuro, tradição e renovação, convidando seus consumidores a viverem jornadas únicas de bem-estar e beleza responsável.
